companies.name: Cobalt AI
companies.description: Cobalt AI (formerly Cobalt Robotics) is a San Francisco based physical security automation company whose Cobalt Monitoring Intelligence platform uses AI handlers to investigate security events across access control systems and video feeds, determine root cause, and trigger automated responses so security teams focus on genuine threats instead of alarm triage. Its offerings include the Cobalt Command Center remote monitoring service and an indoor autonomous security robot, with integrations spanning LenelS2, Genetec, Avigilon, Brivo, Eagle Eye Networks, Milestone, Okta, ServiceNow, Salesforce, and Slack. The company was founded in 2016, backed early by Bloomberg Beta and Sequoia, and acquired in 2024 by Dean Drako, who rebranded it to Cobalt AI.

companies.name: EdSights
companies.description: EdSights is a student voice and engagement platform for higher education. It pairs an AI-powered SMS chatbot with real-time analytics to collect continuous feedback from students, surface persistence and well-being risk, and flag individuals who need staff intervention. Its Student Voice Score (SVS) benchmarks student satisfaction the way NPS benchmarks customers, and institutional dashboards help retention, advising, and student-success teams act on that feedback throughout the academic journey. EdSights serves 290+ colleges and universities and connects to campus systems — Banner SIS, Slate, Salesforce, Starfish, EAB Navigate360, and Pharos — via SFTP data feeds. The company is Techstars-backed. As of this profile EdSights exposes no public developer API, OpenAPI specification, SDKs, or webhooks; integration is data-file (SFTP) based, so most API-artifact enrichment is not applicable.

companies.name: Emidat
companies.description: Emidat GmbH is a Munich-based climate technology company building product intelligence infrastructure for the construction industry. Its SaaS platform lets construction material manufacturers create verified Environmental Product Declarations (EPDs), run Life Cycle Assessments (LCAs), and produce Digital Product Passports (DPPs) at scale. Emidat ingests plant, ERP, and energy-management data through integrations, performs intelligent data matching, and generates ISO-compliant, verified EPDs in as little as a day rather than the typical six to twelve months. The platform also surfaces environmental-impact hotspots so manufacturers can find emission-reduction opportunities and turn sustainability data into business value. Related tools include the public EPD Database and Emidat Atlas.

companies.name: Endowus
companies.description: Endowus is a Singapore- and Hong Kong-based digital wealth management platform founded in 2017 by Gregory Van and Samuel Rhee. It gives retail, accredited, and private-wealth clients access to low-fee institutional share-class funds, advised and self-directed portfolios, and private-market and alternatives strategies across Cash, CPF (Central Provident Fund), and SRS (Supplementary Retirement Scheme) accounts. Its conflict-free model rebates 100% of trailer fees and fund-manager commissions to clients. Endowus is licensed by the Monetary Authority of Singapore (CMS License 101051), serves 300,000+ clients, and manages over US$10 billion in assets. It was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-company lead; the company operates consumer apps but publishes no public developer API or documentation at this time.

companies.name: Finoa
companies.description: Finoa is a Berlin-based, BaFin-regulated digital asset infrastructure provider serving institutional investors, asset managers, family offices, venture capital funds, and regulated crypto service providers. Its platform combines qualified custody, in-custody staking, and prime brokerage across 170+ digital assets and 12 Layer-1 networks, with security and governance controls built for institutional and regulatory requirements. Finoa exposes a gated institutional API surface (api.finoa.io) and a client platform (login.finoa.io / app.finoa.io) rather than a public self-serve developer program. Surfaced as a portfolio company of balderton-capital and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment.

companies.name: Happy World
companies.description: Happy World operates SPICE (getspice.com), a premium lifestyle dining and rewards mobile application based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. SPICE lets diners discover curated partner restaurants across the Kingdom, reserve or walk in, pay their bill in-app by entering the bill number, and earn instant cashback rewards (advertised as up to 20% cashback with no caps) on every visit. The product emphasizes intelligent personalization and a hand-picked selection of the best restaurants, food, and dining experiences. Surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network. The company is a consumer mobile-app business with no public API, developer portal, SDKs, or documented developer surface at this time; this profile captures its identity and public web properties.

companies.name: iContact
companies.description: iContact is an email marketing and marketing automation platform (now part of Cision) that helps small and mid-market businesses build email campaigns, manage contacts and lists, automate drip sequences, and measure engagement. The iContact REST API v2.2 provides programmatic access to contacts, lists, segments, campaigns, messages, and reporting data using a combination of HTTP headers (API-AppId, API-Version, API-Username, API-Password) for authentication.

companies.name: Jack in the Box
companies.description: Jack in the Box Inc. (NASDAQ: JACK), founded in 1951 and headquartered in San Diego, California, is a quick-service restaurant company operating and franchising approximately 2,200 Jack in the Box hamburger restaurants across 21 U.S. states. In December 2021 the company acquired Del Taco for $575M; in August 2025 it announced a strategic review of Del Taco and on October 2025 agreed to divest Del Taco (~600 locations) to Yadav Enterprises for $115M, with the transaction closing December 22, 2025. Digital channels include the Jack in the Box mobile app, Jack Pack loyalty program, online ordering, and integrations with third-party delivery platforms (DoorDash, Grubhub, Uber Eats). The company does not publish a public developer API; all digital ordering, loyalty, and franchise systems are operated via internal platforms and partner integrations.

companies.name: Jaipur Robotics
companies.description: Jaipur Robotics is a Manno, Switzerland based deep-tech company building advanced computer vision and deep learning solutions for the waste-to-energy sector. Its product, Jaipur Intelligence, applies patent-pending image recognition to plant bunkers and truck unloading bays to detect oversized and dangerous items, map the calorific value (LHV) of incoming waste in real time, and track crane operations — helping operators cut emissions, improve waste mixing and combustion stability, and minimize unplanned shutdowns. The company operates a gated customer application at app.jaipurrobotics.com and is backed by Techstars, Innosuisse, Venture Kick, CSEM and others. It currently publishes a marketing site and a customer login only; there is no public developer portal, API reference, SDK, or machine-readable API specification.

companies.name: Juno
companies.description: Juno is a Brazilian B2B payments fintech, acquired by EBANX in October 2021, that provides a complete billing and payments platform for Brazilian companies. Founded in 2014 in Maringá, Paraná, Juno powers more than 35,000 small and medium businesses with online sales and collections via Pix, boleto bancário, boleto_pix, and credit cards, plus marketplace payment split, recurring subscriptions, and a digital business account (Conta Juno) with Banking-as-a-Service capabilities. Juno is a participant of the Brazilian Interbank Payments Chamber (CIP). The company exposes a public REST API v2 through the Juno Developer Academy at integracao.juno.com.br, secured with OAuth 2.0 client_credentials, plus HMAC-SHA256 signed webhooks and native mobile Direct Checkout SDKs for Android and iOS for PCI-safe card data encryption.

companies.name: Komodor
companies.description: Komodor is an autonomous AI SRE platform for Kubernetes observability, troubleshooting, and operations across multiple clusters. The platform surfaces cluster events, deployment timelines, dependency maps, and remediation runbooks to help platform and SRE teams diagnose incidents faster. Komodor exposes a REST API plus a Terraform provider for managing clusters, services, monitors, and policies, authenticated with API keys generated from the User Settings page.

companies.name: Lansweeper
companies.description: Lansweeper is an IT asset discovery and management platform that automatically scans and inventories hardware, software, users, and cloud resources across on-premises, cloud, and OT environments. It provides a unified technology asset intelligence platform used for IT asset management (ITAM), cybersecurity asset management (CAAM), software asset management, and compliance. The Lansweeper Data API is a GraphQL endpoint that exposes the technology asset intelligence stored in your Lansweeper sites using Bearer token authentication.

companies.description: 'Orbio Earth is a climate-tech company (founded 2021; Dover, Delaware, USA and Cologne, Germany)

companies.name: Packhelp
companies.description: Packhelp is a European custom and wholesale packaging platform that lets businesses design, order, and warehouse branded packaging — boxes, mailers, bags, tubes, and accessories — through online design tools and a curated catalog of EU-based producers. Packhelp also markets "the first-ever API for packaging," a sales-gated set of web services that let 3PL, fulfillment, marketplace, logistics, and food-delivery platforms embed packaging quoting, ordering, and a drag-and-drop packaging editor directly into their own applications and whitelabel storefronts.

companies.name: Passport
companies.description: Passport (Passport Labs) is a mobility management platform for cities, universities, and agencies, covering digital parking payments, enforcement, permits, and curbside management, and is used by 800+ agencies. Passport exposes a partner developer program at developer.passportinc.com whose REST APIs let parking apps, navigation apps, in-car infotainment, and mobility/POS systems create and stop parking sessions, quote and determine rates, bulk-export the parking environment (zones, spaces, rules), receive parking event schemas, and manage enforcement immobilizations. Rates and rules are configured once by Passport's customers and pushed to payment providers via API. Access is gated - partners register an application, are issued OAuth client credentials by Passport's identity provider, and only authenticated partner applications may call the public APIs. No SDK is required. Commercial terms are partnership / agency-contract based rather than publicly listed self-serve pricing.

companies.name: Republic Services
companies.description: Republic Services is one of the largest providers of non-hazardous solid waste disposal, recycling, and environmental services in the United States. As a Fortune 500 company, Republic Services serves millions of customers across residential, commercial, industrial, and environmental segments. The company offers waste collection, recycling processing, composting, landfill operations, and digital customer tools for account management, service scheduling, and environmental reporting.

companies.name: Runsybil
companies.description: RunSybil is an AI-native autonomous offensive security platform. Sybil — a system of AI agents — continuously penetration tests live applications and infrastructure, finding, exploiting, and validating real vulnerabilities without a human in the loop. It tests live applications black-box by default (no source code required), integrates with GitHub and GitLab to trigger targeted change testing on every code push, and validates every finding through a multi-agent pipeline before it surfaces, aiming to eliminate triage and false positives. RunSybil positions as a replacement for point-in-time penetration testing, legacy DAST/SAST scanners, and bug bounty programs, and also offers white-box testing for deeper codebase exploration. Founded in 2023 by Ari Herbert-Voss (OpenAI's first security hire) and Vlad Ionescu (Offensive Security Tech Lead at Meta), the company raised $40M led by Khosla Ventures and is trusted by security teams at Notion, Cursor, Turbopuffer, Baseten, and Thinking Machines Lab. No public developer API, SDK, or API documentation surface is published at this time.

companies.name: Sirum
companies.description: SIRUM (Supporting Initiatives to Redistribute Unused Medicine) is a nonprofit and the country's largest redistributor of surplus prescription medication. It connects unused, in-date medicine from manufacturers, wholesalers, pharmacies, and nursing homes with patients who cannot afford their prescriptions, operating under drug-donation laws across the United States. SIRUM runs a logistics and matching platform that routes donated medication to community partners and individuals in need, aiming to close the gap for the tens of millions of Americans who skip prescribed medication because of cost. Surfaced as a Y Combinator portfolio company and profiled in the API Evangelist network.

companies.name: Sourcehut GraphQL
companies.description: Sourcehut (sr.ht) is an open-source software forge offering version control, build automation, bug tracking, mailing lists, and more through a unified GraphQL API. Each service — git.sr.ht, builds.sr.ht, lists.sr.ht, todo.sr.ht, and others — exposes its own GraphQL endpoint at /query, enabling developers to query and manage their projects programmatically with a consistent interface.

companies.name: Stone Co
companies.description: Stone Co. (NASDAQ: STNE) is a Brazilian financial services and payment technology company headquartered in São Paulo. Stone provides card acquiring (POS), digital banking, business management software, and credit products to entrepreneurs and small-to-medium businesses across more than 5,500 Brazilian cities, and is the fourth-largest acquirer in Brazil following its acquisition of Elavon's Brazilian operations. Stone operates several developer-facing platforms: Connect Stone (a POS integration API for in-store payment automation and "infinite shelf" omnichannel inventory), Stone Open Banking (a RESTful banking API for account, balance, TED, PIX, and payment-link operations against Stone accounts and consented third-party accounts), the Stone SDK Android (for embedding card-present payments into Android apps and Pinpad/POS devices), AutoTEF (PIN-pad-based self-service TEF integration), the Conciliação Stone XML reconciliation feed, and Pagar.me (Stone's online/PSP gateway covering orders, charges, customers, subscriptions, split payments, recurring billing, tokenization, and 3DS). Authentication is OAuth2 / PEM-keyed JWT for Open Banking and API-key / credential-based for the other surfaces. Onboarding for Open Banking and Connect Stone partners is gated through Stone's partnerships team; Pagar.me and the Android SDK are self-service. Documentation is primarily in Portuguese and concentrated at docs.stone.com.br, docs.openbank.stone.com.br, connect-stone.stone.com.br, conciliacao.stone.com.br, and docs.pagar.me.

companies.name: Suno
companies.description: Suno is a Cambridge, Massachusetts-based generative AI music company building a consumer platform that lets anyone create original songs from natural language prompts. The product spans text-to-song generation, vocal and instrumental tracks, style and genre control, stem splitting, audio upload and remixing, lyric writing, and Suno Studio for advanced multi-track editing and custom model tuning. The company runs proprietary foundation models for music generation, the latest being v5.5, and ships consumer subscription plans (Free, Pro, Premier) with commercial usage rights on paid tiers. Founded in 2021 by Mikey Shulman, Georg Kucsko, Martin Camacho, and Keenan Freyberg, Suno closed a $250M Series C in November 2025 at a $2.45B valuation led by Menlo Ventures with participation from NVentures, Hallwood Media, Lightspeed, and Matrix. The company has announced a partnership with Warner Music Group. Suno does not publish an official developer API or SDK; the consumer surface is web and mobile applications authenticated via account login, and any third-party "Suno API" offerings are unofficial reverse-engineered wrappers. The suno-ai GitHub organization hosts the open-source Bark text-to-audio model and supporting tooling rather than a Suno product SDK.

companies.name: TreeHouse Foods
companies.description: TreeHouse Foods is one of the largest manufacturers of private label packaged foods and beverages in North America, producing snack and convenience foods for retail grocery and foodservice customers. The company is publicly traded on the NYSE (THS) and is headquartered in Oak Brook, Illinois. TreeHouse Foods produces over 1,600 SKUs across snacking, beverage, and meal preparation categories.

companies.name: Udacity
companies.description: Udacity is an online tech-upskilling platform offering project-based Nanodegree programs, individual courses, and enterprise workforce development across Artificial Intelligence, Generative AI, Agentic AI, Data Science, Cloud Computing, Cybersecurity, Programming, Autonomous Systems, Product Management, and DevOps. Founded by Sebastian Thrun out of the Stanford CS221 free online AI course in 2011, Udacity pioneered the Nanodegree credential and partnered with industry leaders (AWS, Google, Meta, Microsoft, NVIDIA, Mercedes-Benz) to co-develop curriculum. In 2024 Accenture acquired Udacity for approximately $1B and folded the platform into LearnVantage, Accenture's enterprise learning and skilling business. Udacity reports 25M+ learners globally and remains best known for its Self-Driving Car, Deep Learning, and Generative AI Nanodegrees, with hands-on projects reviewed by human mentors and career services. Udacity does not publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal — enterprise customers integrate via Accenture LearnVantage sales channels rather than self-service APIs. Its public GitHub organization (github.com/udacity) hosts 1,100+ open-source classroom and course-content repositories (e.g. deep-learning-v2-pytorch, self-driving-car, cd13303-genai-c1-classroom) used as Nanodegree exercises, not as official platform APIs.

companies.name: Vake
companies.description: VAKE is a Norwegian maritime domain awareness company that detects, identifies, and tracks "dark vessels" from space. The VAKE platform fuses satellite imagery, AIS signals, and machine learning to reveal hidden vessel activity at sea for governments and industry. Its three products are Pathfinder, which reconstructs a vessel's past, present, and predicted movements and searches satellite imagery for vessels that go AIS-dark; Overwatch, which monitors an Area of Interest around ports, critical infrastructure, and economic zones to surface unreported activity such as illegal fishing, transshipments, and spoofing; and Clearview, a machine-learning service that identifies dark-vessel observations in multispectral satellite imagery against a global vessel-signature database spanning 2016 to today. The platform is delivered as a web application (studio.vake.ai) backed by a private API (api.nemme.io); onboarding is sales-led rather than self-serve.

companies.name: Visual Studio
companies.description: Microsoft Visual Studio is an integrated development environment (IDE) for building applications across .NET, C++, web, mobile, cloud, and game platforms on Windows and macOS. While the Visual Studio IDE itself is not exposed as a SaaS REST API, Microsoft provides developer-facing APIs for Live Share real-time collaboration (consumed via the vsls extension SDK) and the Visual Studio Marketplace REST API for discovering and distributing extensions, themes, and tools.

companies.name: WPGraphQL
companies.description: Open-source WordPress plugin that exposes a full-featured extendable GraphQL API for WordPress data including posts, pages, users, menus, taxonomies, media, and plugins. Created by Jason Bahl and now supported by Automattic as a Canonical Plugin, WPGraphQL enables headless WordPress development with modern JavaScript frameworks like Next.js, Svelte, and Astro. The plugin ships with a GraphiQL IDE in the WordPress dashboard and supports custom post types, ACF fields, WooCommerce, and dozens of extension plugins through a flexible schema registration system.

companies.name: WunderGraph Cloud
companies.description: WunderGraph Cloud is the managed cloud platform for WunderGraph Cosmo, the complete GraphQL Federation Stack that enables teams to build, manage, and scale supergraphs from any API across teams. It provides full lifecycle GraphQL API management including schema registry, composition checks, analytics, distributed tracing, and routing through a high-performance open-source federation runtime.

companies.name: XPO
companies.description: XPO, Inc. (NYSE: XPO) is a Fortune 500 transportation company and one of the largest providers of less-than-truckload (LTL) freight transportation in North America. Following the spin-offs of GXO Logistics (contract logistics, 2021) and RXO (brokerage, 2022), XPO is now a pure-play LTL trucking company operating a network of service centers across the United States and Mexico. XPO does not publish a public developer API or developer portal; customer integrations (rate quotes, shipment tracking, EDI) are arranged through enterprise account managers and standard EDI exchanges.

companies.name: XPO Logistics
companies.description: XPO Logistics, Inc. is a leading provider of less-than-truckload (LTL) transportation in North America. The company offers freight transportation through a proprietary network of service centers and uses technology to drive efficiency for more than 50,000 customers. XPO Logistics historically operated as part of XPO, Inc. (NYSE: XPO), the publicly traded company that spun off GXO Logistics (contract logistics) in 2021 and RXO (brokerage) in 2022, leaving XPO focused on LTL trucking. XPO Logistics does not currently publish a public developer API or developer portal; integrations are arranged through enterprise account managers.

companies.name: Zoho Meeting
companies.description: Zoho Meeting is an online meeting, video conferencing, and webinar platform from Zoho that lets teams host secure meetings, presentations, and recorded webinars from any device. The Zoho Meeting REST API enables programmatic scheduling, management, and reporting of meetings and webinars, including registrant handling and session lifecycle. Authentication uses Zoho's OAuth 2.0 (Zoho-oauthtoken) with domain-specific API endpoints.

companies.name: Zscaler
companies.description: Zscaler is a cloud security platform delivering Zero Trust Exchange services including Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA), Zscaler Private Access (ZPA), and Zscaler Digital Experience (ZDX). Zscaler exposes REST APIs across its product suite for configuration, policy management, and reporting, authenticated via API keys, OAuth 2.0, or session-based authentication depending on the product and cloud (zsapi).

companies.name: Aella Credit
companies.description: Aella (Aella Credit) is a technology-driven microfinance bank licensed by the Central Bank of Nigeria (CBN), building consumer and business financial infrastructure across Africa. Its consumer app offers savings, low-interest and same-day loans, bill payments, and high-yield savings accounts, while its Fintech-as-a-Service platform exposes that infrastructure to businesses through a developer-facing API gateway. Published API capabilities include wallet-as-a- service (create and manage digital wallets with real-time balances and full ledger support), KYC/identity verification via BVN and NIN, bank-account lookup and validation, sub-accounts and pooled fund structures for platforms and marketplaces, and direct-debit recurring collections. A live Aella Merchant API is hosted at api.aellaapp.com and a merchant dashboard at merchant.aellaapp.com, though the provider does not yet publish a public developer portal, OpenAPI definition, or SDKs. This profile was seeded as a portfolio company of 500 Global and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline.

companies.name: Alpharank
companies.description: Alpharank is a no-code sales guidance and digital-origination analytics platform for banks and credit unions. It analyzes funded loan and deposit applications to reveal which marketing tactics, channels, and campaigns actually drive funded dollars, then guides institutions to optimize their online branch, curb funnel abandonment, and turn ad spend into higher-quality leads. Its products include Optimizer, AdSync, and CRMSync, and it serves roughly 200 financial institutions nationwide. Originally recognized for turning payment transaction data into customer influence graphs, Alpharank is a 500 Startups / 500 Global portfolio company. As of this enrichment pass Alpharank publishes a marketing and client-login presence but no public developer portal, API reference, or OpenAPI surface.

companies.name: Careport Health
companies.description: CarePort Health, powered by WellSky, is a healthcare technology company providing care coordination and patient transition management across the entire care continuum. Its platform connects hospitals, health systems, ACOs, physician groups, payers, and post-acute providers to manage discharge planning, referrals, transitions of care, emergency department optimization, utilization and authorization management, and value-based programs. Products include Guide, Connect, Insight, Care Management, Transition, Referral Management, Intake, and Discharge, with EHR integrations for Epic and Cerner. CarePort reports covering 14M lives across roughly 2,000 hospitals in 43 U.S. states. It was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead (500 Global, Techstars); no public developer API, developer portal, or documentation surface was found during enrichment.

companies.name: Certivity
companies.description: Certivity is a Munich-based RegTech company, founded in 2021, that operates an AI-native regulatory intelligence platform for regulated industries such as automotive, aerospace, and connected vehicles. Its product, Certivity Core, turns complex regulations, standards, and internal documents into structured, machine-readable, engineering-ready requirements with full traceability and real-time monitoring of legal changes across 50+ jurisdictions. The platform digitizes and structures regulatory content from publishers such as ISO, IEC, CEN, CENELEC, ASTM, UL, and SAE using a proprietary ingestion pipeline and a regulatory knowledge graph, and integrates directly into engineering workflows (including Jama Connect) via an official API. Backed by Earlybird, High-Tech Gruenderfonds, UVC Partners, and Almaz Capital, Certivity added to the API Evangelist network as a company profile and enrichment lead.

companies.name: CoConstruct
companies.description: CoConstruct is a residential construction management software platform originally founded in 2005 in Charlottesville, Virginia by Donny Wyatt to help custom home builders and remodelers manage projects, budgets, selections, client communications, scheduling, and financial workflows in a single web and mobile application. The product served thousands of custom builders across the United States and was paired with CBUSA, a homebuilder group purchasing organization CoConstruct previously acquired. On February 24, 2021, CoConstruct was acquired by Buildertrend of Omaha, Nebraska, with growth funding from Bain Capital Tech Opportunities, HGGC, and Serent Capital, creating a combined company serving 23,000+ clients, 1.1M+ users, and $200B+ in annual construction project value. By 2022 Buildertrend had merged the two products into a single unified Buildertrend platform and migrated CoConstruct customers off the legacy product. CoConstruct historically operated a developer portal at developer.coconstruct.com exposing APIs for project, financial, and scheduling data, but as of the merger CoConstruct has paused new API development — "we are not establishing new API endpoints or connecting additional users to existing endpoints" — and the developer portal now redirects to a static notice page. Existing API connections are reportedly maintained but no public OpenAPI specification, SDK, or open-source release is published. Net-new integration work is directed to Buildertrend's own platform and partner program.

companies.name: Formality
companies.description: Formality is a Paris-based AI platform for end-to-end asset and contract intelligence, aimed at businesses that need to centralize, understand, and track their legal, administrative, and asset-related documents. The product covers the full contract lifecycle: AI-assisted creation and collaborative negotiation, electronic signature, then post-signature data extraction, deadline and obligation alerts, and natural-language analysis of the resulting document estate. Its AI is trained on corporate legal documents, works across multiple languages, and runs inside a secure perimeter with full auditability and no use of customer data for model training. Formality integrates with tools including Google Drive, SharePoint, DocuWare, Docusign, Universign, Yousign, HubSpot, Salesforce, Outlook, Teams, Slack, and Gmail, and runs on compliant hosting with ISO 27001 and SOC 2 Type II certifications and GDPR compliance. It was founded in 2023 and is backed by Partech, Serena, and Bpifrance.

companies.name: Hadrian
companies.description: Hadrian (Hadrian Automation) is a Los Angeles-area precision-manufacturing company founded in 2020 by Chris Power, building software-driven, AI-powered factories that produce high-tolerance machined components for the aerospace and defense industrial base — including parts for rockets, satellites, jets, drones, and missiles. The company's core software stack is Opus, described as a full-stack, AI-powered Factory Autonomy platform that interprets legacy engineering designs, automates CNC machining, inspection, tool-path optimization, adaptive programming, scheduling, and quality assurance, and enables new operators to be productive in 30 days or less. Hadrian operates multiple factories — Factory 2 (F2) and Factory X (FX) in Torrance, California, and Factory 3 (F3) in Mesa, Arizona — and offers three commercial models: precision component manufacturing, Manufacturing-as-a-Service (dedicated automation cells for a single customer), and Factories-as-a-Service (turnkey factory design and operation). Customers and partners include major aerospace and defense primes such as Lockheed Martin. Hadrian has also launched an additive manufacturing division to expand U.S. defense production capacity. The Opus platform is internal-only — Hadrian sells finished precision parts and factory capacity, not software access — and there is no public developer API, SDK, GitHub organization, or open-source release for Opus or any Hadrian system.

companies.name: ilik
companies.description: Ilik (ilikhealth.com) is a direct-to-consumer telehealth company offering personalised prescription skincare designed and approved by dermatologists. Customers complete an online dermatology consultation, receive a custom AM/PM routine built from medical-grade, clinically proven ingredients, and have their prescription medication shipped free to their door — consulting with a dermatologist on their own time without the wait of an in-clinic appointment. The service is organised around skin concerns such as acne, anti-ageing, hyperpigmentation, and rosacea. Ilik is a consumer health / e-commerce brand and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment and monitoring.

companies.name: Intrinsic
companies.description: Intrinsic is a unified Trust & Safety platform that gives safety teams a single API and dashboard to detect, investigate, and enforce against abuse across user- and AI-generated content, fraud, and marketplace abuse. The platform surfaces machine-learning classifiers (for example text toxicity and IP trust scoring), account graph lineage for linkage analysis, geo enrichers, and global intelligence signals through a synchronous API, and lets teams author, version, deploy, and monitor real-time anti-abuse rules from a hosted dashboard. Founded in 2022 in San Francisco by Karine Mellata and Michael Lin (previously on Trust & Safety ML and data-engineering infrastructure at Apple and Discord), Intrinsic has since rebranded to Variance (variance.co); the Intrinsic-branded developer surfaces at docs.intrinsicapi.com and api.intrinsicapi.com remain in service.

companies.name: Kema
companies.description: Kema (Kema FZ-LLC) is a UAE-based B2B fintech providing cash-flow and accounts-receivable tools for SMEs across the MENA region. Its platform combines invoice financing that advances up to 95% of invoice value, accounts-receivable automation with automated reminders, invoice tracking and reconciliation, and branded payment links delivered over email, WhatsApp and SMS that accept cards and wire transfers. Additional capabilities include practice-management tooling for accounting firms, recurring-payment automation, credit assessment and a real-time AR dashboard and analytics. Kema is backed by Speedinvest and reports 4,000+ companies transacting on its network.

companies.name: Kilsar
companies.description: Kilsar is an AI-powered maintenance training and operations platform for the aviation, defense, and industrial sectors. Its flagship product, Orion, turns static technical manuals and maintenance procedures into intelligent, guided workflows so technicians learn faster and perform complex tasks correctly. companies.name: Dokku
companies.description: Dokku is an open-source Docker-powered self-hosted Platform-as-a-Service that helps you build and manage the lifecycle of applications from initial push to scaling out. Often described as "the smallest PaaS implementation you've ever seen" and a self-hosted mini-Heroku, Dokku turns a single Linux host (or a multi-host scheduler such as K3s or Nomad) into a git-push deployment target that builds applications from Heroku-compatible buildpacks, Cloud Native Buildpacks, Nixpacks, Railpack, Dockerfiles, or pre-built Docker images. Dokku is MIT licensed, written primarily in Bash, and maintained by the Dokku organization on GitHub since 2013. It ships an extensive plugin ecosystem covering data stores (Postgres, MySQL, MariaDB, Redis, MongoDB, RabbitMQ, Elasticsearch, ClickHouse, Meilisearch, Typesense), TLS via Let's Encrypt, HTTP basic auth, maintenance mode, redirects, schedulers for Docker, K3s and Nomad, multiple HTTP proxies (Nginx, HAProxy, Caddy, Traefik, OpenResty), CI integrations, and an official GitHub Action. Dokku's primary interface is the `dokku` CLI invoked over SSH; there is no first-party public HTTP REST API in core (the historical `dokku-api` Ruby wrapper is archived and unmaintained).

companies.name: EFEX (Ventu)
companies.description: EFEX (efex.com, formerly efexpay.com) is a cross-border payments and treasury fintech serving businesses across the Americas. It enables international transfers to 140+ countries, bulk and mass payouts for payroll and multi-beneficiary disbursement, multi-currency business accounts (USD, MXN, EUR, GBP, CAD, JPY), international collections in local currency across 24+ countries, and FX and currency management for treasury optimization. Headquartered in Palo Alto, California with operations across Mexico (Mexico City, Monterrey, Tijuana, Queretaro, Guadalajara) and Colombia, EFEX is authorized by Mexico's CNBV as a money transmitter (registration 22469) and regulated by FinCEN in the United States. Backed by 500 Global. As of this profile the company exposes a business web/app product but no public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation.

companies.name: Fannie Mae
companies.description: Fannie Mae, officially known as the Federal National Mortgage Association, is a government-sponsored enterprise that plays a critical role in the American housing market. Established in 1938, Fannie Mae operates as a secondary mortgage lender, purchasing mortgages from banks and other financial institutions. By buying these loans, Fannie Mae helps to provide liquidity to the mortgage market, enabling banks to lend more money to homebuyers. Fannie Mae operates a developer portal that hosts API integrations for mortgage industry partners; access typically requires authenticated business relationships.

companies.name: FYLD
companies.description: FYLD is an AI-native frontline intelligence platform for the global critical-infrastructure sector, turning field-operations data into real-time, structured intelligence for utilities, energy, and heavy-civils operators. Its products include the FYLD Platform for work execution, FYLD Control Room for remote supervision, and FYLD ShowMe for customer self-service reporting, serving managers, fieldworkers, contractors, and civil engineers via web and mobile (iOS and Android) apps. FYLD is a Partech portfolio company. As of this profile FYLD publishes no public developer API, SDKs, or developer portal; integration is delivered through partnerships such as Procore, and this record captures its public identity, security, and trust surface.

companies.name: Genesis Healthcare
companies.description: Genesis Healthcare is a Kennett Square, Pennsylvania based provider of skilled nursing, transitional care, rehabilitation, and assisted/senior living services, operating roughly 175 to 200 centers across 17 to 18 US states with about 27,000 employees serving more than 15,000 residents. Once one of the largest skilled nursing facility operators in the United States, Genesis Healthcare, Inc. filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy protection on July 9, 2025 in the US Bankruptcy Court, citing pandemic aftereffects, inadequate Medicaid reimbursement, legacy liabilities from prior expansion, and roughly USD 8 million per month in litigation defense costs against more than 200 pending malpractice and wrongful death claims. At filing the company reported approximately USD 708 million in secured debt, more than USD 1.5 billion in unsecured debt, and at least USD 259 million owed to malpractice plaintiffs. After the bankruptcy court rejected an insider stalking horse bid from ReGen Healthcare / Pinta Capital Partners in December 2025, a roughly USD 1 billion sale to a NewGen Health backed buyer operating as "101 West State Street" was approved in January 2026, with the restructuring still in progress as of this profile. No public developer APIs, OpenAPI specifications, SDKs, GitHub organization, or developer portal have been identified for Genesis Healthcare; the company is a healthcare operator, not an API provider, and its public web presence is limited to a corporate brochure site, careers portal, and compliance hotline.

companies.name: Menlo Security
companies.description: Menlo Security provides a cloud-delivered Browser Security Platform that protects enterprises and their AI agents at the browser session layer, where most modern attacks and data loss occur. Its core capabilities include pre-render threat prevention using multimodal visual and DOM analysis, patented Positive Selection file security that reconstructs documents to strip malware and macros, AI Adaptive DLP for real-time detection and masking of PII/PHI and financial data, invisible browser isolation for high-risk activity, and Menlo Secure Application Access for identity-based zero-trust access to SaaS, legacy, and private applications for both human users and autonomous agents. The platform integrates with existing SASE/SSE, EDR/EPP, and SOC tooling through a single unified control plane. Menlo Security is privately held and backed by investors including General Catalyst. The company operates primarily as an enterprise security vendor and does not publish a public developer API program; administrative and reporting APIs are available to customers through the authenticated admin console.

The Netskope REST API v2 provides tenant-level programmatic access to events, alerts, incidents, policies, IoCs, SCIM provisioning, and configuration so SOC and platform teams can automate SOAR, SIEM, and IGA workflows using service-account bearer tokens in the Netskope-Api-Token header.

companies.name: NetSuite Accounting

NetSuite exposes its accounting records (invoices, bills, journal entries, payments, accounts, customers, vendors, and ledgers) through SuiteTalk REST and SOAP web services, SuiteQL queries, and RESTlets, secured with OAuth 2.0 and token-based authentication for ERP and finance integrations.

The platform provides automated discovery and risk assessment, ownership and context mapping, posture management, threat detection and anomaly monitoring, policy-driven governance and remediation, time-bound provisioning, and secure secret rotation. Founded in New York and backed by Sequoia Capital, Accel, Cyberstarts, and Maple Venture Capital, Oasis extends zero-trust and PAM practices to the fast-growing population of non-human and agentic identities.

companies.name: OpenX
companies.description: OpenX is an independent supply-side platform (SSP) and programmatic ad exchange headquartered in Pasadena, California, founded in 2008. OpenX connects publishers and app developers to advertiser demand through a real-time marketplace that runs OpenRTB-based auctions across display, video, CTV, native, and mobile inventory. Its product suite is organized around the OpenX Exchange (the core marketplace), OpenXSelect (curation, deal creation, and supply-path targeting), OpenXBuild (a software toolkit for assembling custom supply-side workflows and real-time bidstream integrations), and OpenXControl (publisher yield management and demand routing). OpenX exposes several developer-facing APIs documented at docs.openx.com — an OpenRTB API for DSP bidding integrations, a Platform API for account, inventory, demand, targeting, and deal management, a Reporting API for analytics and performance metrics, an OpenXSelect GraphQL API for managing audiences/deals/inventory lists, and an OpenXBuild Real-Time Bidstream API — but the references are gated behind OAuth and OpenX does not publish a public OpenAPI specification or Postman collection. The company is a major contributor to the Prebid.org header-bidding ecosystem (Prebid.js and Prebid Server) and maintains a large GitHub organization with OAuth-based API client libraries in Python, PHP, Java, Perl, and Ruby for the legacy OX3 API. OpenX's business model is transaction-fee based — it takes a share of each ad impression cleared through its exchange — and access to the developer APIs requires an active OpenX account and BD/account-management onboarding rather than self-service signup.

companies.description: Regbase is an AI-native regulatory intelligence platform that helps legal teams, compliance professionals, researchers, and government vendors monitor new and proposed laws worldwide. Regbase then analyzes those changes automatically and alerts users to updates relevant to their practice areas, spanning employment and labor, AI governance, healthcare, privacy, climate and sustainability, government contracting, and other regulated industries. Founded in 2026 and part of Y Combinator's Spring 2026 batch, Regbase is based in San Francisco. This profile was surfaced as a Y Combinator portfolio company and enriched by the API Evangelist network; at the time of enrichment Regbase publishes a login-only web application and no public API, developer documentation, or SDK.

Scripted also builds native integrations into pharmacy management systems (its first with Liberty RXQ) so pharmacies can run clinical services inside their existing PMS. A Techstars-backed portfolio company; the original scripthealth.co domain now redirects to scripted.co. No public developer API, SDK, or API documentation is published at this time.

The cloud platform covers construction finance and accounting, job costing and CVR, contract and subcontractor management, procurement, inventory and supply chain, plant and equipment, warehouse management, HR and payroll, CRM, and a mobile app for site teams, and is ISO 27001, 27017, 27018, 27701 and SOC 2 certified. The company is a Fortune 500 organization with operations in over 25 countries and a portfolio of digital and robotic technologies including ZBEdge Dynamic Intelligence, ROSA Robotics, the mymobility patient app, Persona Knee, and ZBEdge Analytics. Zimmer Biomet does not currently publish a public REST API developer portal; its digital platforms are surfaced through partner integrations, hospital systems, and proprietary devices.

companies.name: Argus Software
companies.description: Argus Software (ARGUS) is a commercial real estate software provider whose products are the industry standard for cash-flow modeling, valuation, asset and investment management, and development-project appraisal for owners, investors, lenders, and advisors. Founded in Houston, Texas and acquired by Altus Group in 2011, the ARGUS product line is now delivered through Altus Group as the ARGUS Intelligence platform and includes ARGUS Enterprise, ARGUS EstateMaster, ARGUS Developer, ARGUS Taliance, ARGUS ValueInsight, ARGUS Voyanta, and Forbury. ARGUS software is used across the global commercial real estate industry to underwrite acquisitions, perform discounted cash-flow analysis, run portfolio and fund analytics, and standardize valuations. As of this enrichment pass ARGUS exposes no public developer portal, OpenAPI description, or self-service API program; its cloud platform is accessed through the Altus Platform / ARGUS Cloud portal.

companies.name: Barnes & Noble
companies.description: Barnes & Noble is the largest retail bookseller in the United States and the operator of the Nook digital reading platform. Barnes & Noble does not currently publish a public general-purpose developer portal. Trade and affiliate partners integrate through B&N's affiliate program, the B&N Press self-publishing platform for independent authors, EDI-based wholesale channels with publishers, and the Nook content distribution and reading ecosystem.

companies.name: Belts
companies.description: Belts covers the landscape of APIs, data standards, and digital resources related to conveyor belts and industrial belt systems. This topic encompasses conveyor belt monitoring and predictive maintenance APIs, industrial IoT sensor data for belt condition tracking, and the standards bodies that govern belt conveyor design and safety. Key organizations include CEMA (Conveyor Equipment Manufacturers Association) and ANSI, which define design, installation, and safety standards for belt conveyors used in mining, manufacturing, food processing, and bulk material handling industries.

companies.name: Bikky
companies.description: Bikky is a New York-based Customer Data Platform (CDP) built exclusively for large, multi-unit restaurant brands, serving thousands of locations for companies such as Bojangles, MOD Pizza, Dave's Hot Chicken, and Long John Silver's. By integrating with point-of-sale, online ordering, payment, and loyalty systems, Bikky builds a single source of truth on guests, cleaning, standardizing, and de-duplicating data to reveal behavior, frequency, lifetime value, and menu performance across channels. Bikky offers push-button API integrations with leading ordering, loyalty, and marketing providers, plus Snowflake data shares, SFTP, and CSV import for data exchange. It does not appear to publish a public, self-service developer API or documentation; integration and data access are arranged directly with Bikky.

companies.name: Bright Moments DAO
companies.description: Bright Moments is an onchain art organization and decentralized autonomous organization (DAO) that produces live, in-person (IRL) generative NFT minting experiences in cities around the world. Its flagship CryptoCitizens collection (10,000 Art Blocks-powered generative portraits by artist Qian Qian) was minted 1,000 at a time across ten cities including Venice CA (CryptoVenetians), New York, Berlin, London, Mexico City, Tokyo, Buenos Aires, Paris, Venice Italy, and the Metaverse. Holding a CryptoCitizen confers membership and governance rights in the Bright Moments DAO, which was founded on-chain in March 2021. Bright Moments also runs artist collaborations/residencies, a Golden Token minting mechanism, and display software for at-home viewing. It is not a traditional API provider: the public technical surface is Ethereum/Base smart contracts, a documentation site, a DAO portal app, and a public GitHub organization. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Union Square Ventures.

companies.name: Conektto
companies.description: Conektto is an AI-assisted API design and lifecycle platform that helps teams design, simulate, generate, test, and deploy APIs. The platform bundles a Design Studio (NLP-driven contract design), an Autonomous Test Studio (mocking, test generation, test data, and performance testing), a Hybrid API Orchestrator, and an enterprise SDLC workspace. Conektto is delivered as a hosted SaaS workbench with a free Community Edition and a Pro Plan; it does not currently publish a public, self-service developer API for programmatic access to the Design Studio. Customer integrations are surfaced through the SaaS UI, GitHub workspace integrations, and custom enterprise engagements.

companies.name: Craftable
companies.description: Craftable is hospitality's back-office software platform for restaurants, bars, hotels, and resorts, originally known for its Bevager and Foodager products, that connects purchasing, inventory, recipes, and accounts payable with accounting and sales data. Its suite spans Intelligent Ordering (eProcurement), AP Automation with Invoice AI, Inventory and Recipe Management, and Daily Actionable Insights, plus AI features such as Operator AI and the Crafty in-app assistant. Craftable is SOC 2 compliant and SSO-capable, with more than 1,000 POS, EDI, and vendor/API integrations spanning systems such as Toast, Square, Lightspeed, Clover, SpotOn, TouchBistro, Aloha by NCR Voyix, Restaurant365, Sage Intacct, Oracle NetSuite, Acumatica, QuickBooks, and Xero. Craftable does not publish a public self-service developer portal, API documentation, or SDKs; integrations are delivered through its implementation team during onboarding, and API access to a connected platform is provisioned by requesting a scoped API key from that platform's support team.

companies.description: Dewu (POIZON) is a leading Chinese online marketplace for sneakers, streetwear, luxury goods, and collectibles, distinguished by its integrated product authentication (legit-check) service that verifies items before they ship to buyers. Operated by Shanghai-based Poizon and backed by Hongshan (formerly Sequoia China), it runs both the domestic Dewu (得物) app and the global POIZON marketplace. For developers it operates the POIZON / Dewu Open Platform (open.poizon.com and open.dewu.com), a partner program that lets sellers, ISVs, and ERP integrators connect to the marketplace over an app-key plus request-signature authenticated API covering product data, pricing, catalog search, delivery modes, and vendor information.

companies.name: Memorick
companies.description: Memorick is a 500 Global-backed company operating a live web application at memorick.com. Based on its observable application surface, it is a destination photography booking platform connecting customers with photographers across destinations, handling packages, orders, reviews, coupons, and messaging. The product is built on Laravel (Inertia.js single-page front end) and exposes an OAuth2 authorization server via Laravel Passport (authorize/token/clients/scopes plus personal access tokens), Sanctum first-party session auth, and optional two-factor authentication. It publishes no public API documentation, OpenAPI definition, SDKs, or developer portal at this time; the /api/* routes back the first-party application and are authentication-gated. This profile was enriched from live probing of the public surface.

companies.description: Novi Connect (Novi) is an AI shopping optimization platform and data infrastructure for CPG and retail brands. It connects brands, certification bodies, and major retailers to verify, standardize, and distribute product data so products are accurately understood, ranked, and recommended by AI shopping systems and agentic search. Products include the AI Shopping Optimizer for SKU-level product-feed optimization and the Product Authority Builder for verified direct data distribution across retailers and marketplaces. Backed by Felicis. No public developer API surface is currently published; product docs are hosted on Notion and customer access is via login apps.

companies.name: Amp

The AMP contract (0xff20817765cb7f73d4bde2e66e067e58d11095c2) supports partitioned staking, registered collateral managers, and operator authorization, and has been independently audited by ConsenSys Diligence (June 2020) and Trail of Bits (August 2020). Amp is smart-contract-only and exposes no REST/HTTP API; its published "API reference" documents the on-chain contract interface. companies.description: Prosimo is a multi-cloud networking platform that gives enterprises a full-stack cloud transit, security, performance, observability, and cost-management layer across AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, and Oracle Cloud. Its Application eXperience Infrastructure (AXI) abstracts cloud-provider networking constructs and ties network transit, micro-segmentation, zero-trust policy, WAF, and observability into an autonomous, ML-driven control plane. Prosimo exposes that control plane programmatically through a first-party Terraform provider (prosimo-io/prosimo) for full lifecycle management of cloud gateways, network and application onboarding, policies, namespaces, and security profiles; a companion Pulumi bridge repository and reusable Terraform modules are published on GitHub. Prosimo was venture-backed by General Catalyst, WRVI Capital, and BlackRock; industry sources report it was subsequently acquired by Palo Alto Networks.

companies.name: Sensefinity
companies.description: Sensefinity is a supply-chain IoT company ("The IoT Transformation Company") delivering real-time tracking, monitoring, and analytics for global cargo and logistics operations. Its platform combines GPS/NB-IoT tracking devices for maritime containers, pallets, and vehicles with temperature and condition (cold-chain) sensors, indoor location tracking, a cloud analytics and machine learning layer, and digital product passport / blockchain integrations. The operational platform is delivered as a hosted web application (uiadmin.sensefinity.com) and mobile asset-management apps, serving enterprise customers across food, pharma, automotive, and manufacturing supply chains. No public developer portal, OpenAPI specification, or SDK surface is published as of this profile; a private API host (api.sensefinity.com) backs the platform.

companies.name: Spectra (Defunct / Merged into OVG360)
companies.description: Spectra (formerly Spectra Experiences, originally Comcast-Spectacor Ventures / Global Spectrum + Ovations Food Services + Paciolan + Front Row Marketing) was a North American venue management, food services & hospitality, and partnership-sales company headquartered in Philadelphia, PA. Owned jointly by Comcast Spectacor and Atairos, Spectra was acquired by Oak View Group (OVG) in a deal announced August 31, 2021 and closed on November 15, 2021 after receiving U.S. Department of Justice approval. On February 25, 2022, OVG formally consolidated Spectra and OVG Facilities into a single, rebranded division called OVG360. The Spectra and Spectra Experiences brands were retired as a result, and the spectraexperiences.com domain is no longer resolvable. This apis.yml is preserved as an historical record only — Spectra never published a public developer API, OpenAPI specification, SDK, or developer portal. Operational successor: OVG360 (https://www.oakviewgroup.com/ovg360-2/). Ticketing platform Paciolan, which had been part of the Spectra portfolio, was divested before the OVG deal and is now an independent Learfield subsidiary.

companies.name: Theom
companies.description: Theom is a cloud Data & AI Operations Center that governs and secures enterprise data estates, providing automated data security, compliance, and safe generative-AI data activation across multi-cloud environments. Founded in December 2020 by former Cisco, Google, and Yahoo security practitioners (creators of Tetration Analytics), Theom detects active data breaches, maps real-time data lineage, analyzes identity-aware data usage and insider threats, and enforces data-usage policy agentlessly. Its product spans Theom Core (data security and lineage), Theom AI (GenAI leak prevention), and Theom Trust (real-time data contracts). Theom is backed by Wing Venture Capital, Ridge Ventures, Snowflake Ventures, Databricks Ventures, SentinelOne Ventures, and M12, and was named a Leader in the 2026 Forrester Wave for Sensitive Data Discovery and Classification. Theom is delivered as an enterprise platform; it does not publish a public developer API, SDKs, or API docs.

companies.name: Togal.AI
companies.description: Togal.AI is a Miami, Florida construction-technology company building AI-powered takeoff and estimating software for the architecture, engineering, and construction (AEC) industry. Founded by former U.S. Congressman Patrick Murphy out of his family's multi-generational construction business, the cloud-based platform applies computer-vision and deep-learning models to architectural drawings and blueprints to automatically detect, measure, count, label, and compare project spaces and features — reporting up to 98% accuracy against AIA measurement standards and reducing manual estimating effort by roughly 80%. Signature capabilities include the Togal Button (one-click automated takeoff), AI-powered image, text, and pattern search across plan sets, drawing-set comparison for change quantification, real- time multi-user cloud collaboration, and Togal.CHAT, a natural-language assistant that lets estimators query plans, verify quantities, identify errors, and draft RFPs. The product serves drywall, electrical, mechanical, plumbing, glazing, landscaping, painting, FF&E, and general-contracting trades, with documented case studies (e.g., Coastal Construction) showing multi-hour-per-plan-set savings and seven-figure annual ROI. Togal.AI's revenue model is SaaS subscriptions sold to estimators, subcontractors, and general contractors; there is no public developer API, SDK, or open-source release, and the only known third-party integration is Service Titan plus data export to Excel and downstream estimating tools.

companies.name: Trackonomy
companies.description: Trackonomy is a supply chain visibility company that digitizes real-world operations

companies.name: Vestwell
companies.description: Vestwell is a New York City-based digital savings and retirement platform (founded 2016) that powers workplace savings programs for employers, financial advisors, financial institutions, TPAs, PEOs, payroll and benefit partners, and government agencies. Its recordkeeping and administration engine supports traditional and Safe Harbor 401(k), Solo-k, Starter-k, pooled/PEP plans, 403(b), 529 education savings, ABLE, emergency savings, student-loan repayment, and tuition reimbursement, as well as state-facilitated ("government savings") retirement programs. Vestwell emphasizes payroll and HR integrations (auto-sync across 190+ payroll providers) rather than a public developer API; onboarding, servicing, and saver access run through its web platform. Surfaced as a Lightspeed Venture Partners portfolio company and profiled here for the API Evangelist network.

companies.name: Zatanna
companies.description: Zatanna is a Y Combinator (W2026) startup based in San Francisco that creates APIs for software that doesn't have any. It reverse-engineers the back ends of web-based cloud and on-prem software — ERPs (SAP), PMS/POS systems, insurance portals, and marketplaces — by observing real workflows, reconstructing the underlying request sequences, and hosting them as clean, callable APIs. Rather than relying on slow browser automation or computer-use agents, Zatanna gives AI agents faster, cheaper, and more reliable integrations, with a reliability layer that handles session management, authentication, and change detection. The agent-facing surface is a hosted, OAuth-protected Model Context Protocol (MCP) server at api.zatanna.ai.

companies.name: Zurich Open Data
companies.description: Zurich Open Data is a municipal government open-data portal for Switzerland running CKAN. It exposes the CKAN catalog API over approximately 925 datasets.

companies.name: Amplication
companies.description: Amplication is an open-source backend development platform that generates production-ready microservices — REST APIs, GraphQL endpoints, data models, DTOs, and supporting infrastructure code — from a domain model, embedding organizational best practices and standards so teams avoid repetitive backend coding. The project is TypeScript-based, distributed as @amplication npm packages and an `amp` CLI, and remains actively maintained on GitHub (16k+ stars, v3.15.0). Originally offered a hosted product at app.amplication.com; the hosted service and docs subdomain have since been retired and the amplication.com root now redirects to overcut.ai (the founders' agentic-SDLC venture), while the open-source project, npm packages, and Discord community continue.

companies.name: Classiq
companies.description: Classiq Technologies is a Tel Aviv, Israel headquartered enterprise quantum software company founded in 2020 by Nir Minerbi (CEO), Amir Naveh (CPO), and Dr. Yehuda Naveh (CTO), positioning itself as a high-level quantum algorithm design platform that lets organizations build, scale, and deploy quantum algorithms across any hardware or simulator without writing low-level gate code. Its flagship offering centers on Qmod, an intuitive quantum modeling language, and a hardware-aware synthesis engine that compiles functional quantum models into optimized circuits with constraint-driven optimization, transpilation, and execution session management across cloud quantum providers including AWS Braket, Azure Quantum, GCP, IBM Quantum, IonQ, OQC, Alice and Bob, and C12. The platform is delivered through the Classiq Studio web IDE at platform.classiq.io, a public Python SDK (`pip install classiq`) currently at version 1.14.0 covering synthesis, execution, analysis, and application libraries for chemistry (QSP), finance (IQAE), and quantum machine learning (QSVM, QML), plus an AI-assisted natural language interface for algorithm design. Classiq publishes the largest open quantum algorithm library on GitHub at github.com/Classiq/classiq-library (2,000+ stars, Jupyter Notebook, MIT license) with reference implementations across optimization, linear solvers, quantum machine learning, chemistry, finance, logistics, cybersecurity, and physical systems. Customers include Microsoft, AWS, NVIDIA, HSBC, Citibank, BMW, and Rolls-Royce; the company is SOC 2 and GDPR compliant. Classiq has raised over $200M including a $110M Series C in May 2025 with backers such as AMD Ventures, Qualcomm Ventures, IonQ, Bank Leumi, Mirae Asset Capital, and SoftBank. Classiq's developer surface is the Python SDK and Qmod language — there is no public REST API or OpenAPI specification; the Mintlify-hosted `docs.classiq.io/api-reference/openapi.json` endpoint currently returns the default Mintlify Plant Store placeholder rather than a real API contract.

companies.name: Cypherium
companies.description: Cypherium is a permissionless Layer-1 blockchain built to bridge centralized (CeFi) and decentralized (DeFi) finance and bring real-world assets on-chain at scale. It runs CypherBFT, a hybrid consensus that pairs GPU proof-of-work committee election with HotStuff Byzantine Fault Tolerance for near-instant finality, and is EVM/Solidity compatible (EVM chain ID 16166). Products include CypherLink (cross-ledger notary), Cypherium Connect (bank integration plugin, marketed as ISO 20022 compliant), the Cypherium Validator, and Cypherium ID (decentralized identity). Developers integrate through an Ethereum-style JSON-RPC node API (eth/web3/net/ personal/miner/txpool/admin namespaces over HTTP, WS and IPC) and a Coinbase Rosetta API implementation for exchange and wallet integration. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Pantera Capital and enriched into the API Evangelist network.

companies.name: Feesable
companies.description: Feesable is a fintech infrastructure company providing embedded finance and debt capital management (treasury) tooling that connects platforms, lenders, and capital markets. Its Embedded Finance product delivers white-labeled loan origination infrastructure — KYC/KYB verification, credit decisioning, dynamic pricing, fraud detection, and servicing/collections — exposed through APIs, SDKs, and embeddable widgets so SaaS platforms, marketplaces, and B2B lenders can launch embedded lending without building fintech from scratch. Its Debt Capital Management (DCM Engine) product provides institutional-grade treasury management — credit facility modeling, covenant monitoring, borrowing-base calculations, and automated lender/regulatory reporting connected to live portfolio data. Feesable targets GCC markets with Shariah-compliant options and is a portfolio company of 500 Global. The developer surface (APIs, SDKs, sandbox keys, documentation) is partner-gated behind a partnership onboarding process rather than publicly self-serve.

companies.name: Fidor Bank
companies.description: Fidor Bank was a German digital challenger bank founded in Munich in 2009 and an early pioneer of Banking-as-a-Service and open banking through its fidorOS / bankOS middleware platform and public REST API, which covered Customers, Accounts, Transfers, Transactions and Account Information over an OAuth2 authorization-code flow. Fidor was acquired by France's Groupe BPCE in 2016; following years of post-acquisition integration struggles the bank ceased business operations in mid-2023 and entered liquidation. Its developer portal (fidor.com) is now a parked domain and the sandbox and production API hosts are offline. The surviving first-party developer artifacts are the archived official Ruby client (RubyGems: fidor_api, by Fidor Solutions AG) and the github.com/fidor organization. This is a retired provider retained for historical reference.

companies.name: Figure1
companies.description: Figure 1 is a Toronto-based social platform and mobile app for verified healthcare professionals to view, share, and discuss real-world, de-identified patient cases and medical images. Founded in 2013 by Dr. Joshua Landy, Richard Penner, and Gregory Levey, it has grown to more than one million healthcare professionals and one of the world's largest libraries of crowd-sourced medical cases, with trained specialists reviewing and de-identifying each image before publication. Figure 1 also produces the DDx medical podcast and a clinical blog, and in 2024 formed the parent company Formedics with Physician's Weekly to deepen healthcare-professional engagement. It is a portfolio company of Union Square Ventures. Figure 1 is a consumer/professional, mobile-first product with no publicly documented developer API.

companies.name: FREE NOW
companies.description: FREE NOW is one of Europe's leading multi-mobility "super apps," letting riders book taxis and private-hire vehicles and, in many cities, e-scooters, e-bikes, e-mopeds, carsharing and public-transport tickets from a single application. Founded in Hamburg in 2009 as mytaxi and rebranded FREE NOW in 2019, the company operates across nine European countries and 150+ cities. It ran as part of the YOUR NOW mobility joint venture between Mercedes-Benz and BMW and was acquired by Lyft. FREE NOW exposes a partner/business integration API (FREE NOW for Business) through a password-gated developer portal at developer.free-now.com, and maintains an active open-source presence — including the Wave design system — under the freenowtech GitHub organization.

companies.name: Gangkhar
companies.description: Gangkhar is an AI-native embedded protection infrastructure platform that lets digital platforms, insurers, MGAs, and brokers configure, launch, and continuously optimize embedded insurance products globally through a single infrastructure layer and API. Its Sherpa+ engine provides full-stack embedded protection rails covering onboarding, pricing, underwriting, and claims across multiple carriers and markets, while Sherpa+Lens applies real-time AI optimization to pricing, messaging, and product versions. The platform enables sectors like mobility, delivery, fintech, e-commerce, travel, health, and vertical SaaS to embed compliant protection directly into their customer experiences without becoming insurers themselves. Founded in 2025 and led by former Chubb executive Federico Spagnoli, Gangkhar closed a $4.25M seed round in March 2026 led by Anthemis. Surfaced as an Anthemis portfolio company and enriched into the API Evangelist network.

companies.name: General Intuition
companies.description: General Intuition is a frontier AI lab, founded in 2025 and spun out of Medal, building spatial-temporal world and action models that learn to perceive, anticipate, and act in space and time. Rather than training primarily on the archive of human language, its systems learn from gameplay data, teaching machines to play, dream within compressed simulacra of reality, and improvise within the unfolding dynamics of the world. The company is developing a commercial API for gaming, simulation, and robotics partners, with broader access planned through 2026. General Intuition is backed by Khosla Ventures, which led both its $133.7M seed round (October 2025) and its $320M Series A at a $2.3B valuation (2026).

companies.name: Illumix
companies.description: Illumix is an enterprise-grade spatial AI company spun out of Stanford's Computer Science Department, providing a core stack for real-world location intelligence that runs at the edge with centimeter-level precision. Its hardware-agnostic platform delivers sub-second localization and 3D mapping across mobile devices, AR/VR wearables, and robotics using standard cameras — with no LiDAR or GPS dependency — combining multimodal vision-language AI with long-term memory that learns behavior over time. Illumix serves AI/XR wearables, enterprise and logistics, defense and security, location-based entertainment, and robotics, with deployments referenced for Disney, Six Flags, Cedar Fair, MGM Resorts, Warner Bros, Verizon, and Sony. The company markets developer APIs and an SDK as part of a full-stack offering, but publishes no public developer portal, reference documentation, or machine-readable API specification at this time.

companies.name: Jaspersoft
companies.description: Jaspersoft is a business intelligence and embedded analytics platform, now part of Cloud Software Group (formerly TIBCO). Its flagship products are the open-source JasperReports Library — a Java reporting engine (net.sf.jasperreports) — and JasperReports Server, a reporting and analytics server that exposes a REST API (rest_v2) for managing the repository, running and scheduling reports, executing queries, and administering users, roles, and organizations. Developers embed Jaspersoft content into their own applications with Visualize.js and the js-visualize component library, and interact with the server programmatically through official Java and PHP REST clients. Sector: data analytics / business intelligence. Backed by Sapphire Ventures; surfaced into the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company.

companies.name: Juleb
companies.description: Juleb is a Saudi Arabia-based pharma-tech and retail software company providing an integrated cloud platform for the health, retail, and distribution sectors. Its suite spans accounting and financial management, inventory and warehouse management, sales force automation (SFA), point of sale (POS), Rx e-prescription, e-commerce, and DSCSA regulatory compliance. Juleb connects to Saudi compliance systems (ZATCA/Fatoora, RSD, GS1, Wasfaty), e-commerce channels (Salla, Shopify, HungerStation), payment providers (Geidea, Alhamrani), and ERPs (Microsoft Dynamics). Founded by Yousuf Jamjoom and backed by 500 Global, Juleb exposes a REST API (documented at docs.juleb.com) covering inventory, point of sale, prescriptions, and partner/company resources.

companies.name: Nevis Wealth
companies.description: Nevis (Nevis Wealth) is an AI platform built for wealth management firms, giving financial advisors an AI assistant that automates administrative work — AI-generated meeting summaries, automatic task capture from client interactions, intelligent meeting-prep briefs, unified AI search across advisory systems, personalized client email drafting, and account-opening automation — so advisors spend more time with clients and less on paperwork. The company is used by advisory firms including United Capital, GC Wealth, Apollon Wealth, and Dodds Wealth, is SOC 2 Type I certified, and has raised $40M in venture funding. Nevis does not currently publish a public API, developer portal, SDKs, or developer documentation.

companies.name: NewDays
companies.description: NewDays is a cognitive health company backed by General Catalyst that delivers a clinically proven, Medicare-covered program for people living with mild cognitive impairment (MCI) or dementia. The service pairs a dedicated licensed cognitive clinician with AI-guided brain-training exercises delivered remotely from home: a free consultation, ongoing telehealth sessions, and clinician-supervised AI exercises between visits. NewDays reports that 75% of participants showed improved cognitive function on ACE-III assessments and that dementia participants delayed symptom progression by more than a year versus an untreated baseline. NewDays is a direct-to-patient telehealth offering with no public developer program, API, SDKs, or documentation surface; this profile captures the company's identity and public web properties for the API Evangelist network.

companies.name: Olli Health
companies.description: Olli Health is an AI-powered managed service for home health agencies that automates medical coding and OASIS (clinical assessment) and Plan of Care quality review. It pairs clinical artificial intelligence with certified human coders to ingest patient documentation (faxes, handwritten notes, and digital records), produce ICD-10 coding and OASIS review, and push approvals back into existing EHR workflows. The company reports 98%+ accuracy, roughly 4x faster turnaround, and about half the cost of traditional coding vendors, serving 100+ agencies and 200,000+ patients. Olli Health is HIPAA compliant, SOC 2 certified, and its OASIS/Plan of Care quality review service is CHAP Verified. Added to the API Evangelist network as a Techstars portfolio company; as of this enrichment pass Olli Health publishes no public API, developer portal, or machine-readable API specification.

companies.name: Profluent
companies.description: Profluent is a Berkeley, California AI biology company building frontier protein language models and using them to design functional proteins for therapeutics, gene editing, agriculture, and industrial enzymes. Founded by Ali Madani — previously architect of the ProGen large language model for proteins at Salesforce AI Research — Profluent pairs in-house foundation models with a wet lab to author novel proteins from scratch and validate them experimentally. The company's research has been published in Nature Biotechnology and Nature, and it is best known for OpenCRISPR-1, which it describes as the world's first AI-designed gene editor, released freely for research and commercial use. Profluent also publishes the ProGen3 family of protein generation models, ProseLM for structure-conditioned protein design, the E1 family of protein encoder models, Protein2PAM for CRISPR-Cas PAM specificity prediction, and the CRISPR-Cas Atlas dataset. Commercial partnerships include a multi-target collaboration with Eli Lilly worth up to $2.25 billion, and deals with Ensoma, Corteva, Integrated DNA Technologies, and the Rett Syndrome Research Trust. Profluent is backed by Spark Capital, Insight Partners, Air Street Capital, Altimeter, and Bezos Expeditions. The company does not publish a hosted developer REST API or commercial SDK; its surface area for external builders is the Profluent-AI GitHub organization (model weights and inference code), the Protein2PAM web tool, and partnership engagements.

companies.name: Provenmetal
companies.description: ProvenMetal is a Y Combinator (Summer 2026) startup building fast-turn, American-made printed circuit board (PCB) assembly. The company lets customers upload a Gerber file, automatically infers the board specification, and returns instant quoting for a 7-day standard turnaround with no expedite fees. ProvenMetal automates the traditional manufacturing bottlenecks — part procurement, design for manufacturability (DFM) review, and assembly — and performs 100% X-ray inspection of every board (AI-assisted, cited at 99.8% confidence) before shipment, including the inspection data with each order. It is a domestic B2B PCB manufacturing service aimed at reshoring electronics production, operated out of San Francisco. As of this profile ProvenMetal exposes a customer ordering portal at order.provenmetal.com but publishes no public developer API, SDKs, or technical documentation.

companies.name: Scorpion
companies.description: Scorpion is an American marketing technology company that provides revenue-focused advertising, marketing, and software services to local and multi-location businesses in home services, legal, franchise, and healthcare verticals. Founded in 2001 by Rustin Kretz and headquartered in Salt Lake City, Utah (with major operations in Valencia, California), Scorpion pairs done-for-you digital advertising and SEO with its own AI-driven platform. In 2024 it launched RevenueMAX, an AI marketing platform built on Scorpion AI that aligns marketing spend, intake, and long-term revenue, and in 2025 it introduced Scorpion Convert, an AI intake-and-conversion product that automates response, scheduling, and voice/messaging engagement for missed leads. Scorpion is a services-and-platform provider; it does not publish a public developer API, developer portal, or SDKs.
