companies.name: Sware (fka BTR)
companies.description: Sware (formerly BTR) is a life sciences software company providing AI-driven GxP validation for regulated life sciences and pharmaceutical organizations. Its Res_Q SaaS platform combines a decade of validation intelligence with a Data Cloud and AI agents that automate validation work, surface insights, and keep every decision explainable, traceable, and reversible. A companion product, GxPNext, delivers agentic validation built for software development so teams can embed GxP validation directly into their applications, ship faster, and simplify customer audits. Sware serves quality, regulatory, and engineering leaders across software validation, AI/ML validation, plant and equipment validation, and medical device / SaMD development, and publishes SOC 2 and ISO 9001 certifications. It is backed by Insight Partners. No public API, developer portal, or OpenAPI is available today (the Res_Q API page is password-gated), so this profile captures the company's public identity, compliance posture, and domain-security probe.

companies.name: Augury
companies.description: Augury is a New York City-headquartered industrial AI company founded in 2011 by Gal Shaul and Saar Yoskovitz that profiles itself as the leader in Machine Health and Production Health for manufacturing. Its flagship offering pairs purpose-built IoT vibration, temperature, and magnetic sensors — most prominently the Halo Node and earlier Auguscope hardware — with a cloud platform that applies prescriptive AI diagnostics to rotating and electrical equipment, advertised as delivering 75% fewer false alarms than threshold-based vibration systems and trained on more than one billion hours of machine monitoring data. Augury's product portfolio spans Machine Health (predictive maintenance for assets such as motors, pumps, fans, compressors, and gearboxes), Process Health (process optimization software acquired with Seebo in 2022 for yield, waste, and energy improvements), and an Industrial AI Workforce of AI agents that act on combined machine and operational data. The company runs an integration ecosystem branded Augury Plus (CMMS/EAM connectors for SAP PM, IBM Maximo, Infor EAM, MaintainX, and cloud/industrial platforms including Microsoft Azure, PTC, and AVEVA Connect), Augury On (OEM-embedded Machine Health with partners such as Grundfos, Schneider Electric, Trane, Carrier, Bently Nevada, and Baker Hughes), and Augury By (service partners including Accenture, Deloitte, Bain, McKinsey, Sodexo, Aramark, and AECOM). Augury closed a $75M Series F in February 2025 at a $1B+ valuation led by Lightrock with Insight Partners, Eclipse, Qumra Capital, La Maison Partners, SE Ventures, and Qualcomm Ventures, reports a 5x revenue increase since 2021, and serves 170+ global manufacturers across 40+ countries including Heineken, PepsiCo (Frito-Lay), Colgate-Palmolive, Shell, and Hershey's. The company commercializes through hardware-plus-subscription contracts and embedded OEM agreements, references public APIs and certified system integrator partners for custom integrations into customer enterprise systems, and does not publish an open developer portal, OpenAPI description, SDK, or public-facing API reference for the Halo platform.

companies.name: Hidden Level
companies.description: Hidden Level is a U.S.-based defense and aerospace technology company that turns radio-frequency (RF) activity into trusted airspace intelligence. Its passive RF sensing platform detects and tracks unmanned aerial systems (drones) and other activity across air, ground, sea, and space domains without requiring emitters or heavy on-site infrastructure. Hidden Level packages this as hardware sensor platforms, software platforms, and data platforms serving defense and military, critical infrastructure protection, homeland security, and public safety customers. The company hosts its platform on AWS with least-privilege access, MFA, and TLS 1.3 API communications, aligns corporate controls to NIST SP 800-171, and emphasizes U.S. design and manufacturing. Backed by Costanoa Ventures. This API Evangelist profile tracks Hidden Level's public web and security surface; the company does not currently publish a public developer portal, API reference, or SDKs.

companies.name: Identiq
companies.description: Identiq operates a privacy-preserving, peer-to-peer identity validation network that lets member companies confirm a customer is already known and trusted by other members without any party sharing, exposing, or centralizing personal data. Its patented anonymized protocol keeps identity data encrypted inside each member's own environment while answering cross-network trust queries in real time. Products include customer identification, sign-up validation, risk-based onboarding, payment optimization, and trust & safety, serving travel, e-commerce, ticketing, fintech, telco, and marketplace verticals. Identiq is a cybersecurity company backed by Insight Partners and was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead; it publishes a public trust center but no public developer API.

companies.name: Laureate Education
companies.description: Laureate Education, Inc. is a for-profit higher-education network founded in 1989 as Sylvan Learning Systems and renamed Laureate Education in May 2004. At its 2017 IPO peak the company operated more than 200 campuses across 28 countries serving over one million students; it became only the third B Corporation to go public when it listed on NASDAQ (ticker: LAUR) on 1 February 2017. Between 2018 and 2021 Laureate executed one of the largest sector-wide divestiture programs in the history of higher education, exiting Brazil (sold to Ânima Holding for ~$765M), the United States (Walden University sold to Adtalem for $1.48B), Australia / New Zealand (sold to Strategic Education), Chile (Universidad Andrés Bello transferred to Fundación Educación y Cultura in September 2020), Spain, Portugal, Morocco, Turkey, Malaysia, China, Italy, Cyprus and the United Kingdom — returning $1.29B to shareholders in October 2021. After the divestiture cycle Laureate continued as a pure-play Mexico / Peru operator with five remaining institutions and approximately 460,000 students. In May 2024 the company was acquired by an investor group led by the International Finance Corporation (IFC, a member of the World Bank Group) and Sterling Capital, taking Laureate Education private and delisting it from NASDAQ. The company is headquartered at 1000 Brickell Avenue, Suite 715, Miami, FL.

companies.name: Layer
companies.description: Layer is a living digital art platform that curates code-based generative artwork and ultra-high-resolution video art for everyday display. Its developer surface is an artist-facing, first-party TypeScript SDK (a browser global, $layer) that lets creators declare customizable parameters, register a canvas for screenshot capture, and supply generated video previews back to Layer Studio, alongside published guidelines for generative and Ultra Res artwork. Layer is a portfolio company of Bloomberg Beta and Emergence Capital, added to the API Evangelist network and enriched from its public developer documentation. Layer exposes a client-side SDK rather than a public REST/HTTP API.

companies.name: Manex AI
companies.description: Manex AI (Manex AI GmbH) is a European enterprise AI company that builds Kosmos, an Autonomous Enterprise AI Platform for industrial and manufacturing OEMs and their suppliers. Kosmos models the domains a business runs on and lets AI agents, workflows, and applications act on full enterprise context instead of fragments. Oligo combines Cloud Application Detection and Response (CADR), runtime software composition analysis (SCA) and SBOM generation, container scanning, and AI security posture management to detect and stop attacks at the application layer before they spread. By observing which vulnerable code actually executes at runtime, Oligo proves exploitability and reduces vulnerability noise by up to 90-99%, letting teams prioritize the small fraction of findings that are truly reachable. The platform covers apps, workloads, hosts, and cloud infrastructure, and adds runtime protection for AI agents and models. companies.name: Freed
companies.description: Freed is a San Francisco-based AI medical scribe and clinician assistant designed to reduce the documentation burden on healthcare providers. The product listens to patient visits and generates SOAP-style clinical notes, visit summaries, patient instructions, referral letters, and ICD-10 / CPT coding suggestions, then transfers the finalized note into the clinician's EHR via a browser-resident agent. Freed was founded in 2023 by former Facebook engineers Erez Druk (CEO) and Andrey Bannikov (CTO) after Druk's wife, a practicing family physician, experienced the daily toll of manual charting. The company is consumer self-serve: clinicians sign up for a 7-day free trial and then a monthly Starter, Core, Premier, or custom Groups plan with no enterprise sales required. As of 2025 Freed reported more than 20,000 paying clinician users and raised a $30M Series A led by Sequoia Capital, bringing total funding to $34M. The platform is HIPAA-compliant, SOC 2 Type II certified, and HITECH-ready; patient recordings are not stored. Rather than ship a traditional public REST API, Freed pursues an "anti-integration" model in which a Chrome-extension AI agent navigates any web-based EHR (Athena, Tebra, PracticeFusion, TherapyNotes, SimplePractice, Elation, AdvancedMD, Cerbo, and others) to place the finished note in the correct fields. Funding has come from M13 Ventures, Equal Ventures, Act One Ventures, Chingona Ventures, and CEAS Investments, with an $18M Series A reported by TechCrunch in 2021. MosaicML's surviving open-source artifacts include Composer (a PyTorch training library with built-in speedup recipes), Streaming (a cloud-native dataset format for efficient distributed training), LLM Foundry (the training code behind Databricks' DBRX foundation model), the Diffusion training stack, and the MCLI command line and Python SDK that orchestrate Pretraining and Finetuning jobs against the managed training service. The Mosaic AI Training service itself is accessed exclusively through the MCLI command line, the mosaicml-cli Python SDK, and Databricks workspace integrations — there is no publicly published REST OpenAPI surface for the training control plane. Commercial access requires a Databricks account; pricing is consumption-based via Databricks DBU billing rather than an independent MosaicML pricing page.

companies.description: Onramp Payments, Inc. (ONRAMP) is a fintech company building modern payments infrastructure for the commercial trucking and fleet industry. Founded by logistics and payments veterans and backed by Canaan Partners, the company operates an enterprise-grade digital platform that replaces legacy card-based fleet payment systems. For carriers it offers cardless fuel payments at the pump, administrative spend controls, and maintenance payment solutions; for merchants it provides digital payment acceptance, pricing controls, and fraud prevention that work both in-store and at fuel pumps; and for partners it offers API integrations, broker solutions, and Transportation Management System (TMS) connections. companies.name: Paraglide
companies.description: Paraglide is a British-Swedish AI company building autonomous agents that automate accounts receivable for high-volume B2B finance teams. Its agents handle two-way billing communication across the order-to-cash lifecycle: answering customer billing questions, chasing overdue invoices, resolving disputes and deductions, running collections, operating a supplier portal, and applying cash — integrating with ERPs, CRMs, and billing software to cut Days Sales Outstanding and improve cash flow. Founded in 2025 by Rasmus Areskoug and Andreas Astrom with offices in London and Malmo, Paraglide raised a $5M seed round led by Bessemer Venture Partners and DN Capital in January 2026. As of this profile the company is a product/agent platform with no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface.

companies.name: Pienso
companies.description: Pienso is an interactive no-code AI and machine learning platform, founded in 2016 out of MIT by Karthik Dinakar and Birago Jones and headquartered in the Washington, DC / Arlington, VA area. It lets subject-matter experts explore, train, fingerprint, annotate, and deploy deep-learning and large language models over unstructured text — customer calls, emails, documents, and social content — through a point-and-click interface with no coding required. Product capabilities include Ingest, Train & Fingerprint, Annotate, Dataset Analysis, and PromptFactory, applied to use cases such as customer insight, content moderation, document intelligence, and risk detection. Pienso is deployed into the customer's own environment — AWS, Azure, GCP, Gcore, or on-premises — so data never leaves the customer's control, and the company publishes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface; integration is sales-led and the platform runs as a self-contained system. companies.name: Polaron

Its platform applies machine learning to microscopy and image data to automate microstructure analysis, connecting process, structure, and performance so materials engineering teams can characterise, design, and manufacture materials faster and with less uncertainty. The platform centers on three core model families: Segmentation (identifying and measuring microstructural features), Reconstruction (converting 2D micrographs into 3D representations), and Design (optimising microstructural parameters). It is applied across batteries, metals and alloys, composites, ceramics, additive manufacturing, and pharmaceuticals, spanning R&D, quality and qualification, and modelling and simulation workflows. Polaron is backed by Speedinvest and research institutions including Imperial College London, Manchester, Oxford, and Cambridge.

PostgreSQL does not expose a native HTTP REST API; client applications connect via the libpq C client library, JDBC, ODBC, or one of dozens of language-specific drivers using the PostgreSQL wire protocol (default port 5432).

EditorConfig files are easily readable and work well with version control systems. FANUC does not operate a public REST developer portal or publish OpenAPI specifications; integrations are partner-driven through MTConnect adapters, OPC UA servers, FIELD system edge apps, and the FANUC America customer/training portals.

Its product portfolio spans six-axis articulated robots (KR series), sensitive collaborative robots (LBR iiwa, LBR iisy), mobile platforms (KMR iiwa, KMP), and palletizing/welding/CNC cells, controlled by the KR C4 and KR C5 / KR C5 micro controller generations. The robot software stack centers on KUKA System Software (KSS/VSS) for KR C4-class hardware, the newer iiQKA.OS / iiQKA.OS2 operating system for KR C5, and the KUKA Robot Language (KRL) for motion programming, with extension surfaces including KUKA.RobotSensorInterface (RSI), KUKA.EthernetKRL, KUKA.PLC mxAutomation for external PLC control, KUKA.OPC UA, and KUKA.AppTech / iiQKA App Builder for option packages. Engineering and simulation are delivered through iiQWorks (iiQWorks.Sim, iiQWorks.App Builder, iiQWorks.Copilot) and KUKA.Sim, while operational software includes KUKA Xpert (documentation/cloud), KUKA iiQoT (condition monitoring), and KUKA Connect / my.KUKA customer portals. KUKA does not publish a first-party public REST/OpenAPI developer API or an official GitHub organization for its robot control stack; integration is performed through proprietary protocols (RSI, EthernetKRL, mxAutomation, OPC UA, PROFINET, EtherCAT) and SDKs distributed via the iiQKA Creator portal and KUKA Xpert. A meaningful body of open-source KUKA integration code lives in the community-maintained kroshu GitHub organization (ROS 2 drivers, external-control SDK, URDF robot descriptions) and the roboticsapi / openkuka projects. KUKA serves automotive, electronics, battery, metal, consumer goods, healthcare, aerospace, and e-commerce logistics customers, and through its Swisslog subsidiary extends into warehouse and intralogistics automation.

In late 2023 Olive sold its clearinghouse and patient access business to Waystar, and in early 2024 sold its prior authorization business to Humata Health, then ceased operations. companies.description: PricewaterhouseCoopers (PwC) is one of the Big Four professional services firms, with approximately 370,000 staff across a global network of member firms coordinated by PricewaterhouseCoopers International Limited (PwCIL). PwC organizes delivery across three primary service lines — Assurance (audit), Tax (tax compliance, planning, and reporting), and Advisory (consulting, deals, and risk). The firm operates proprietary technology platforms including PwC Halo (a suite of data analytics tools used to support audit engagements), the Trusted AI initiative (PwC's responsible-AI governance and assurance framework), and ProEdge (a workforce upskilling platform). In April 2024 PwC announced a multi-year alliance with OpenAI positioning the firm as both OpenAI's largest customer and its first reseller of ChatGPT Enterprise, supporting PwC's broader generative-AI consulting practice. PwC's research and insights surface — pwc.com/insights, the annual Global CEO Survey, the Global Workforce Hopes and Fears Survey, the Money Tree report, and regional industry outlooks — is the firm's primary public-facing knowledge product. PwC does not publish a public developer portal, OpenAPI specifications, partner API documentation, or a GitHub organization at the corporate level. The github.com/pwc handle is held by an unrelated individual user (Patrick Clearwater). Any technical integrations with PwC platforms are arranged through engagement contracts and the PwC Technology Consulting practice rather than through self-service developer credentials. PwC's content distribution is reader-facing (newsletter subscriptions, the PwC US Newsroom, LinkedIn, YouTube) with no documented public RSS feed endpoint exposing news, press releases, or insights as a syndication contract.

companies.name: Quantum Machines
companies.description: Quantum Machines is a Tel Aviv, Israel-based quantum control company that builds the Quantum Orchestration Platform (QOP) — a unified hardware and software stack for controlling quantum processors at the pulse level. Its hardware portfolio centers on the OPX+ and OPX1000 controllers, which are built around a custom Pulse Processing Unit (PPU) architecture that executes classical control and real-time feedback alongside arbitrary waveform generation, with sub-microsecond classical-quantum round trips and 160 ns active reset latency. The platform is programmed in QUA, the company's domain-specific pulse-level language, exposed to developers through the qm-qua Python SDK and an extensive open-source ecosystem under the qua-platform GitHub organization (QUAlibrate, QUAM, qua-libs, py-qua-tools, qua-dashboards). Quantum Machines also ships peripheral hardware including the Octave up/down converter (to 18 GHz), QDAC-II ultra-low-noise DACs, QSwitch, QBox, and the QCage/QBoard/QFilter cryogenic line. The platform is qubit-modality agnostic, supporting superconducting, semiconductor spin, trapped-ion, neutral-atom, and color-center systems, and is used by university labs (MIT, Caltech, Harvard, Princeton, Weizmann) and quantum startups (Alice & Bob, Diraq, EeroQ). Quantum Machines has partnered with NVIDIA on the DGX Quantum hybrid quantum-classical compute platform and acquired the Delft-based QHarbor Bioscience team as a European R&D hub. Quantum Machines does not currently publish a public REST API, OpenAPI specification, or self-service developer signup; the QOP control surface is reached exclusively via the qm-qua Python SDK against an OPX/OPX1000 controller (hardware or qm-saas cloud simulator).

Rabobank publishes a developer portal at docs.developer.rabobank.com (legacy URL developer.rabobank.nl redirects there) exposing PSD2-mandated open banking APIs (Account Information, Payment Initiation, Funds Confirmation) as well as Premium / Beyond-PSD2 commercial APIs for corporate cash management and notifications, with sandbox endpoints for development and a regulated production tier under PSD2 Strong Customer Authentication. Underlying schemes are aligned with the Berlin Group NextGenPSD2 XS2A Framework.

Regard positions itself around "earning revenue through better care, not queries," spanning clinical notes, mid-revenue-cycle denial prevention and revenue capture, HCC risk-adjustment capture, and screening for care gaps. The Share SDK is accessed by application through partners@remind.com and the developer console at remind.com/integrations; there is no public self-serve REST API, no published OpenAPI specification, and no general-purpose messaging API for sending Remind messages from third-party systems.

Satellite is backed by Multicoin Capital and its code is MIT licensed.

TrustArc exposes a developer surface through gated APIs documented in the customer help center — including the Gateway API, Individual Rights Manager Rapid/Client APIs, Cookie Consent Manager Reporting API, Consent & Preference Manager Rapid/Standard APIs, and Assessment Manager Internal API — plus a Mobile Consent SDK (iOS), 300+ prebuilt connectors to platforms such as Salesforce, HubSpot, Marketo, Adobe Experience Manager, Microsoft Dynamics, Jira, and Google Workspace, and a Google Consent Mode v2 template published on GitHub. Founded over 28 years ago and serving 1,500+ enterprises including Abbott, ADP, GE, Nike, and Starbucks, TrustArc operates on a commercial SaaS model; complete API specifications are not publicly available.

companies.name: Agrapp
companies.description: Agrapp is a Chilean agricultural technology (AgTech) company offering "el cuaderno de campo inteligente" (the intelligent field notebook) — a mobile and web SaaS platform that helps small and medium farmers record, track, and manage their field operations without complex spreadsheets. Founded in 2016 in Santiago and backed by 500 Global, Start-Up Chile, OpenBeauchef, and ChileGlobal Ventures, the platform provides labor and task tracking with per-task cost analysis, inventory and supply (bodega) control, a work calendar, worker attendance and performance monitoring, WhatsApp and email alerts, and agricultural plus financial reporting to support data-driven decisions. It runs on iOS and Android with an offline mode that syncs when connectivity returns. Agrapp does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer documentation; this profile captures its public web surface, commercial links, and domain security posture.

companies.name: Apparta
companies.description: Apparta is a Colombian hospitality technology company providing a reservation-management and guest-engagement platform for restaurants, bars, and dining venues across Latin America (Bogota, Medellin, Cali, Barranquilla). The SaaS product covers AI-assisted table assignment and floor-plan zoning, no-show prevention with prepayments and cancellation policies, a WhatsApp AI chatbot for automated bookings, CRM campaigns over SMS/email/WhatsApp, POS integration, branded booking pages and digital menus, and marketing connectors to Google, Google Maps, Instagram, TripAdvisor, and Facebook. Apparta is offered in tiered monthly plans (Basico, Standard, Plus) and is a portfolio company of 500 Global. No public developer API or OpenAPI surface is published as of this profiling; higher tiers expose a WhatsApp Business API integration on behalf of venues rather than a first-party Apparta API.

companies.name: Arc Simulations
companies.description: Arc Simulations is a London-based sports technology company, founded in 2022 by Henry Smith and Michael Armenakis and part of the Techstars London Spring 2024 accelerator cohort. Arc builds ball-tracking and simulation technology for cricket and other ball sports: professional-standard cricket balls carry embedded tracking tags that transmit position data to sensors up to 200 times per second, feeding a real-time simulation and analytics platform. The system predicts ball trajectory post-impact from velocity, angle and spin to deliver millimetre-accurate, autonomous feedback for every shot, with customisable field configurations that mirror live match scenarios. Arc serves players, coaches, scouts, analysts, broadcasters and fans through a hosted application (app.arcsim.io) and a player-facing app (player.arcsim.io) offering ball-by-ball 3D simulations. Arc's technology is built first for cricket but is designed to track nearly any sports ball. No public developer API, SDK, or API documentation is published at this time; this profile captures the company's identity and web/security posture in the API Evangelist network.

companies.name: Authy
companies.description: Authy is a two-factor authentication (2FA) product originally built by Authy Inc. and acquired by Twilio in 2015. It provided a consumer authenticator app (TOTP soft tokens, encrypted cloud backup, and multi-device sync) alongside a developer-facing Authy API for one-time passwords over SMS and voice, soft tokens, and push authentication. Twilio has since folded the Authy developer API into the Twilio Verify API, deprecated and archived the first-party Authy client SDKs, and discontinued the Authy desktop applications in 2024. The consumer Authy mobile app remains available. New integrations are directed to Twilio Verify. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio-company lead and is enriched here from Authy's remaining public surface (marketing site, archived GitHub organization, and deprecated SDK registries).

companies.name: Automax Ai
companies.description: Automax AI is a fintech company delivering AI-native residential property appraisals built for modern mortgage lending and the UAD 3.6 standard. Lenders order signed residential appraisals directly from their loan origination system (LOS) and get them back in days rather than weeks, combining AI-assisted market data analysis with licensed appraiser review. The platform pairs a hybrid appraisal workflow (automated mobile data capture of floor plans and photos plus human quality review) with an Appraisal Copilot report-writing and analysis suite, automated appraiser matching and assignment, nationwide licensed-appraiser coverage, and real-time order status tracking. Automax AI is a Y Combinator portfolio company. As of this profile the company exposes web and mobile applications (an appraiser Copilot at copilot.automax.ai and an iOS app) but publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI specification, or developer portal.

companies.name: Cabal
companies.description: Cabal is an AI-powered relationship-intelligence and warm-introduction platform that turns an organization's professional relationships into warm introductions. It infers connections across millions of professional records without CSV uploads or calendar syncs, letting teams "ask who's connected to anyone." Cabal serves VC platform / deal-sourcing teams, sales organizations, and investor-relations and partnerships teams, and ships Cabal Mail for bulk personalized outreach (company updates, LP communications, strategic asks). The relationship graph is queryable through in-app chat, Claude and ChatGPT via the Model Context Protocol (MCP), a Slack bot, or an API. Backed by Craft Ventures. This profile was enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline from Cabal's public surface; the company advertises API and MCP access but does not publish a public OpenAPI spec or open developer reference (both are account-gated).

companies.name: Come Bien

Employees choose from a rotating seven-week cyclical menu each day, place their order through the Come Bien app, and receive individually bagged, ready-to-eat meals delivered to the workplace in 100% biodegradable packaging. A dedicated backoffice platform lets employers subsidize, administer, and gain full visibility into their team's food benefit. Backed by 500 Global, the company reports serving 100+ companies, 10,000+ employees, and more than 1.5M orders delivered.

companies.name: Covariant
companies.description: Covariant is an Emeryville, California warehouse-robotics AI company founded in 2017 (originally as Embodied Intelligence) by UC Berkeley professor Pieter Abbeel and his former students Peter Chen, Rocky Duan, and Tianhao Zhang. The company builds the Covariant Brain, a universal AI platform that enables industrial picking robots to handle virtually any SKU regardless of shape, size, or packaging, and in March 2024 it introduced RFM-1 (Robotics Foundation Model 1), an 8-billion-parameter multimodal transformer trained on text, images, video, robot actions, and numerical sensor readings to give robots human-like reasoning over the physical world. Covariant ships AI-powered solutions for order picking, sortation, item induction, kitting, depalletization, and goods-to-person workflows, delivered through long-running integration partnerships with KNAPP (Pick-it-Easy Robot, since 2020) and ABB (warehouse robotics, since 2020), as well as deployments with retailers and logistics providers worldwide. In August 2024, Amazon announced a non-exclusive license to Covariant's robotic foundation models and hired its three co-founders along with roughly a quarter of its workforce in a reverse-acquihire arrangement; Covariant continues to operate independently under COO-turned-CEO Ted Stinson and co-founder Tianhao Zhang. The Covariant Brain and RFM-1 are proprietary, deployed on-premise on partner robotics hardware, and the company has no public developer API, SDK, open-source release, or third-party developer program.

companies.name: Evermore
companies.description: Evermore (formerly Soda Health, rebranded in October 2025) is a Chicago-based healthcare technology company, founded in 2021, that administers "Smart Benefits" — supplemental benefit programs connecting Medicare Advantage, Medicaid, and commercial health-plan members to the products and services they need. Its Smart Benefits card restricts spending to eligible items at the point of sale (item-level adjudication) across categories such as healthy food, OTC medications, transportation, and utilities, and can hold separate funds per benefit type. Evermore partners with payers, health plans, and a retail network (including grocers such as Save A Lot) to deliver consumer-directed health (CDH) accounts, Medicare Advantage supplemental benefits, Medicaid value-added benefits, and ICHRA administration through an API-based platform. The company runs a HIPAA/CMS-compliant program and is backed by General Catalyst, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Qiming, Define Ventures, and SVB Capital.

companies.name: Hudl
companies.description: Hudl is a Lincoln, Nebraska sports performance and analytics technology company founded in 2007. The company started as a video sharing and review platform for high school, college, and professional teams and has grown into a global provider of video capture hardware, performance analysis software, and sports data services. Hudl operates across basketball, baseball, football, ice hockey, rugby, soccer, softball, and volleyball, serving customers from youth clubs through professional leagues. The company's product portfolio spans the core Hudl video platform, Hudl Focus AI-powered capture cameras (Indoor, Outdoor, Flex, Point), Hudl Replay and Hudl Studio for live and tactical analysis, Hudl IQ for American football analytics, Volleymetrics, the Hudl TV livestreaming product, and Hudl Tickets digital ticketing. Through acquisitions Hudl has consolidated several leading performance analysis and football data brands under its umbrella, including Sportscode (performance analysis software), Wyscout (the largest soccer video and stats database), Statsbomb (advanced football analytics), Instat (video and scouting), WIMU and Titan (athlete tracking and wearables), and Signal and ADI. Hudl exposes commercial developer surfaces primarily through Hudl Wyscout (Wyscout Data API, documented as OpenAPI 3.0 at apidocs.wyscout.com, with Database, Stats, Events, and Physical Data packs) and Hudl Statsbomb (the Statsbomb Aggregated API for player-match, player-season, team-match, and team-season data, accessed via the Data Hub, plus the Raw X&Y Tracking Data API and a Wyscout/Statsbomb ID Mapping API). Core Hudl video and Hudl Focus do not publish a public developer API; B2B integrations are sales-mediated. Hudl maintains a public GitHub organization (github.com/hudl) with infrastructure, resilience, and media tooling open source projects (Mjolnir, Fargo, HudlFfmpeg, react-native components), but these are engineering libraries, not product SDKs. Hudl's revenue model is SaaS subscriptions for video, analytics, and data packages, plus camera hardware sales and data licensing.

companies.name: KAYAK
companies.description: KAYAK is a global travel meta-search engine headquartered in Stamford, Connecticut, owned by Booking Holdings (NASDAQ: BKNG). Founded in 2004 by Steve Hafner and Paul English, KAYAK aggregates results from hundreds of online travel agencies, airlines, hotel chains, car-rental companies, and cruise providers to help travelers compare prices for flights, hotels, cars, vacation packages, and cruises across a single interface. The company operates the KAYAK consumer brand, the HotelsCombined and Momondo meta-search brands, and KAYAK for Business, a corporate travel platform. KAYAK also runs a global Affiliate Network that lets publishers, content sites, and travel partners embed KAYAK search via co-branded search forms, iframes, deep links, and white-label search pages, with revenue share on redirected click traffic. KAYAK does not publish a self-serve public REST or GraphQL API for third-party developers; the consumer experience is delivered through its websites, native apps, voice integrations (Alexa, Google Assistant), and chat surfaces (Slack, Messenger). Programmatic access is limited to vetted partners under the KAYAK Affiliate Network and KAYAK Partner Network agreements, which typically expose XML/JSON feeds, deep-link builders, white-label search results pages, and conversion tracking — all gated behind a partner application process. There is no public OpenAPI specification, no published SDK, and no developer portal for KAYAK's underlying meta-search infrastructure.

companies.name: Polycam
companies.description: Polycam is a cross-platform 3D scanning and capture company building consumer and professional tools for turning the physical world into high-fidelity 3D content. Its iOS, Android, and web apps support LiDAR-based space capture, photogrammetry, photosphere capture, AI-generated 3D models, and Gaussian Splat reconstructions, with export formats including glTF/GLB, OBJ, FBX, DAE, STL, USDZ, point clouds, and CAD-friendly files. Polycam serves freelancers, AEC and real-estate teams, VFX and game studios, e-commerce sellers, and enterprise operators with 2D/3D floor plans, measurement tools, shared team libraries, virtual walkthroughs, AI reports, custom branding, SSO, and TransformEngine for custom 3D file creation. Revenue is subscription based across Free, Basic ($30/mo or $150/yr), Business ($400/yr per user), and Enterprise tiers, with sales-led pricing for organizations at scale. Polycam exposes a developer mode in the iOS app that unlocks a raw-data export bundle (raw.glb mesh, keyframes, images, cameras, depth maps, confidence data, mesh_info.json) used by partners such as Vuforia, Immersal, and Unity/Unreal workflows, and ships an open-source Python toolkit (polyform) for converting raw captures to NeRF and other research formats. As of this profile there is no public REST API, OpenAPI specification, or developer portal — integrations happen through raw exports, partner pipelines, and the Polycam app surface itself.

companies.name: CLAUDE.md
companies.description: CLAUDE.md is the markdown-based project memory format used by Anthropic's Claude Code CLI to give the model persistent, session-spanning instructions about a codebase. CLAUDE.md files are plain markdown that Claude Code loads at the start of every session by walking up the directory tree from the working directory, picking up files at organization-managed, user (~/.claude/CLAUDE.md), project (./CLAUDE.md or ./.claude/CLAUDE.md), and local (./CLAUDE.local.md) scopes. The format supports an @path import syntax for composing files together (up to five hops, relative or absolute), HTML block comments that are stripped before injection, an AGENTS.md import pattern for compatibility with other agents, and a complementary .claude/rules/ directory of path-scoped markdown rules with YAML frontmatter. CLAUDE.md is the human-authored counterpart to Claude Code's auto memory at ~/.claude/projects/<project>/memory/MEMORY.md, which Claude writes itself.

Its vision and language models let operators search any camera feed in plain language to find any object, person, or situation in real time, raise automatic alerts, and investigate recorded footage in seconds — turning passive surveillance into active intelligence. Unlike legacy analytics that depend on preset object or motion definitions, Conntour's models scale to thousands of concurrent feeds (up to roughly 50 feeds per consumer GPU such as an Nvidia RTX 4090) and deploy fully on-premises, in the cloud, or in a hybrid mix, either augmenting existing VMS/security systems or serving as a standalone surveillance platform. Founded in 2024 by Matan Goldner and Tomer Kola, the company serves intelligence agencies, homeland security, law enforcement, military and defense, transportation, and enterprise customers. It raised a $7M seed round in March 2026 led by General Catalyst, with participation from Y Combinator, SV Angel, and Liquid 2 Ventures.

The group provides legally compliant, audit-proof digital archiving (GDPR, GoBD, eIDAS), document management (DMS), invoice and procure-to-pay (P2P) processing, contract management, and HR/HCM software with automated workflows, plus AI services and connectors for SAP and Microsoft 365 / SharePoint. Solutions are offered cloud-native, in a private cloud, on-premises, or hybrid, and are relied on by more than 8,700 companies and organizations worldwide. conrizon is a portfolio company of Battery Ventures. It publishes a corporate marketing site but no public developer API or developer portal.

The pipeline spans two first-in-class clinical-stage programs (including DR-01 and DR-0202) plus multiple preclinical and discovery-stage programs across oncology, autoimmune disease, immunology, and neurology. Dren Bio has established strategic collaborations with Pfizer and Sanofi, the latter of which acquired its DR-0201 (SAR448501) bispecific myeloid cell engager program. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of 8vc and added to the API Evangelist network. companies.name: Drover AI
companies.description: Drover AI is a Los Angeles-based micromobility technology company that pioneers the use of computer vision, machine learning, and proprietary sensor fusion in shared light electric vehicles (LEVs) such as e-scooters and e-bikes. Its flagship PathPilot module is a plug-and-play IoT unit retrofit onto existing fleet vehicles that delivers granular infrastructure distinction (sidewalk, bike lane, crosswalk, street), real-time parking validation, and the ability to control vehicle behavior (speed reduction, throttle disable) based on rider location. The Drover Corral dashboard surfaces real-time compliance insights and validation to operators and cities in line with the MDS 2.0 standard, delivered via API and automated Slack alerts. Partners and customers include Spin, Voi, Bolt, Beam, Dott, and Felyx. Drover AI is a portfolio company of 500 Global. companies.name: Field AI
companies.description: FieldAI builds general-purpose robot intelligence through its Field Foundation Models (FFMs) and EDGE brain — a new class of physics-first, risk-aware foundation models for embodied AI. FieldAI's embodiment-agnostic autonomy lets robots navigate dynamic, unstructured environments without maps, GPS, or predefined trajectories, and has been proven across quadrupeds, humanoids, wheeled robots, and passenger-scale vehicles. Founded in 2023 (formerly AI for Humanity) and based in Mission Viejo, California, the company is led by veterans from DeepMind, Google Brain, Tesla Autopilot, NASA JPL, and SpaceX, and serves construction, energy, mining, logistics, manufacturing, power and utility, agriculture, and federal applications. FieldAI has raised over $405M from investors including Bezos Expeditions, Canaan Partners, Khosla Ventures, Temasek, Intel Capital, Hyundai Motor Company, and Prysm Capital.

companies.name: Field AI
companies.description: Field AI is a physical-AI robotics company founded in 2023 and based in Mission Viejo, California, building Field Foundation Models (FFMs) — a class of risk-aware, embodied AI that gives general-purpose robots a single "brain" (marketed as EDGE) that works across many robots, tasks, and unstructured real-world environments. Its Belief World Model reasons under uncertainty and runs entirely on the edge, without pre-built maps, GPS, or pre-programmed paths, integrating vision, LiDAR, and other multimodal sensor data. Field AI has production deployments across three continents and serves construction, urban operations, industrial and energy, federal/government, manufacturing, mining, power and utility, and agriculture, with partnerships including Boston Dynamics, NVIDIA (Omniverse), and Certis. The company is backed by Khosla Ventures. companies.name: Schrödinger
companies.description: Schrödinger is a New York-headquartered (NASDAQ: SDGR) computational science company that develops a physics-based and AI-driven molecular simulation platform used across drug discovery and materials science. Its flagship desktop modeling environment is Maestro (MS Maestro for materials science), which integrates a deep stack of computational tools — Glide (docking), FEP+ (free energy perturbation), Desmond (molecular dynamics), Jaguar (quantum chemistry), Prime (protein structure prediction), BioLuminate (biologics), LigPrep, QikProp, SiteMap, and WaterMap — together with the Schrödinger-maintained PyMOL visualization system. LiveDesign is the cloud-native enterprise design lab where chemists, biologists, and program teams collaborate on molecules, run computational workflows, and integrate experimental data; it exposes a snap-in API framework for connecting in-house and third-party tooling. The Schrödinger Python API (current release 2026-1) is the primary developer surface, providing programmatic access to molecular structures, Maestro automation, jobcontrol, Glide, FEP+, Desmond, Jaguar, MacroModel, Prime, BioLuminate, and LiveDesign integration (login, export, dataset and column management). Schrödinger also ships KNIME extensions, command-line drivers for every computational product, and maintains a meaningful open-source footprint on GitHub — including PyMOL, maeparser, coordgenlibs, sketcher, gpusimilarity, csmiles, and the fixed-data-table-2 React component. The business has two segments — software licensing to global pharma, biotech, and materials companies, and a co-developed and proprietary drug discovery pipeline. There is no public developer signup or self-serve REST API; access to the platform, Python API, and LiveDesign is gated through commercial licensing and the my.schrodinger.com customer portal.

companies.description: Blocto is a Web3 smart-contract wallet built by Portto that lets everyday users interact with decentralized applications without managing seed phrases, using a chain-agnostic account-abstraction architecture. For developers, Blocto ships a client-side integration surface — the JavaScript Blocto SDK, a Blocto-flavored Flow Client Library (FCL) fork, plus Go, Swift and Rust SDKs — to connect dApps to the Blocto wallet for authentication, transaction signing and account-proof verification across Flow, Ethereum, Solana, Aptos, Polygon, BNB Chain, Avalanche, Arbitrum and Optimism. companies.name: Cartesi
companies.description: Cartesi is a Linux-based optimistic rollup protocol that lets developers build decentralized applications by running rich off-chain computation inside a sandboxed Linux virtual machine. The core of the stack is the Cartesi Machine, a deterministic RISC-V emulator that boots a real Linux userland so dApps can be written in any language (Rust, Go, Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, C++) using familiar libraries, then settle results on Ethereum and other EVM chains through Cartesi Rollups smart contracts. Cartesi Rollups 2.0 is the current major version, packaging an application-specific rollup as the combination of the Cartesi Machine, the Cartesi Rollups Node middleware (Rust + Go), and a set of Solidity rollup contracts that handle settlement, consensus, and data availability. The DAVE permissionless fraud-proof system provides Stage-2 trust minimization, while the Cartesi CLI (the successor to Sunodo) packages scaffolding, build, and local devnet workflows. Cartesi is stewarded by The Cartesi Foundation and the CTSI token governs the network. Cartesi is fully open source under Apache-2.0 and LGPL-3.0 licenses on github.com/cartesi; there is no proprietary SaaS product, but the Rollups Node ships several developer-facing surfaces — the Rollup HTTP API used by application backends, the Inspect HTTP API for read-only queries from frontends, a GraphQL reader for advance-state inputs / outputs / vouchers / notices / reports, and a JSON-RPC node API for operations.

CodeSecure merged with AdaCore in 2025, combining SAST and SCA tooling with high-integrity software development for aerospace, automotive, defense, medical, and industrial customers. The tools support SARIF, CWE, MISRA, CERT, and OWASP as well as safety standards such as ISO 26262, IEC 61508, EN 50128, and DO-178C, and integrate with CI/CD, IDE, and issue-tracking pipelines rather than exposing a public developer REST API.

companies.name: Divebell
companies.description: Divebell is a cloud-native data privacy and security compliance platform that helps organizations discover, classify, and protect sensitive data and personally identifiable information (PII) across their data sources. The platform pairs continuous, intelligent data scanning with "Deep Automation" to deliver four capability areas: Data Discovery (data classification, data mapping, and access management), Compliance Automation (risk assessment, data retention, and regulatory compliance), DSR Fulfillment (data subject request workflows, subject mapping, and automated retrieval), and Risk Protection (a policy engine, "Risk Sonar," and remediation actions). Delivered as a lightweight modern SaaS with private data processing, Divebell protects customer data across sources such as Snowflake and AWS. Divebell was surfaced as a portfolio company of Uncork Capital and is now part of the Exterro family, operating as Exterro Data Discovery.

Founded in 2014 in Sofia, Bulgaria by brothers Svilen and Konstantin Rangelov and operating as Dronamics Group Limited, the company is building the world's first cargo drone airline, operating a proprietary drone fleet from a network of low-cost droneports. Echo integrates with major learning management systems (7+ LMS platforms) so universities and colleges can bring existing course video into compliance at institutional scale. The company is SOC 2 certified, completed a pre-seed round, and is a Techstars portfolio company. This API Evangelist profile tracks Echo Labs as a company in the network; the provider does not publish a public API or developer portal at this time.

For developers, EcoG OS exposes an on-device programmatic surface (an OpenAPI-based application interface, a local web interface, and the LifeC remote management tool) so smart value-added charging applications can be built and run at the device level. This profile was surfaced as a Techstars portfolio company and enriched from EcoG's public website; it publishes no public REST API developer portal or specification.

companies.description: Octant (Octant Bio) is a precision-medicine and therapeutics company based in Emeryville, California, founded by Sri Kosuri and Ramsey Homsany. Octant engineers small-molecule drugs that modulate cellular mechanisms behind serious disease, with a focus on protein misfolding and mistrafficking disorders. Its Navigator platform merges synthetic biology, massively parallel experimentation in human cells, high-throughput chemistry, and AI/ML to understand and modulate how target proteins actually behave inside cells. Programs span rare genetic diseases (including autosomal dominant retinitis pigmentosa and Fabry disease), oncology, metabolism, and immunology. Octant is backed by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z) and Catalio Capital Management. companies.name: Output
companies.description: Output is a Los Angeles-based music software company founded in 2013 by composer and CEO Gregg Lehrman that makes creative virtual instruments, audio effects, and a cloud-connected subscription platform for music producers, songwriters, composers, and beatmakers. Its flagship product is Arcade, a cloud-powered playable sampler and instruments plugin whose library of vocal chops, chords, melodies, basslines, loops, samples, and chromatic instruments (organized into product lines such as Hooked, Poolside, and Drip) refreshes daily. Output's catalog also includes Co-Producer, a sample-discovery plugin that finds samples that fit the current project, and the Output FX suite — Portal (granular synthesis engine), Thermal (interactive distortion engine), and Movement (rhythm engine) — alongside legacy Kontakt-based instruments such as Exhale, Analog Brass & Strings, REV, Signal, and Substance. Products are sold as one-time perpetual licenses and bundled in the Output One subscription ($14.99/month or $119.99/year) covering Arcade, Co-Producer, and the three FX plugins with all expansion packs included. Output raised a $45M Series A from Summit Partners in 2020. Products are delivered as VST3, AU, and AAX plugins (Arcade also runs as a standalone desktop app) installed via account.output.com and the Output Hub; there is no public REST API, SDK, or developer program — integration is through the industry-standard DAW plugin formats.

companies.name: Sylvera
companies.description: Sylvera is a London-headquartered carbon data and climate intelligence platform — often described as the "Moody's for the voluntary carbon market" — providing independent ratings, market data, and geospatial analytics that help corporate buyers, investors, project developers, governments, and standards bodies make informed decisions across carbon and commodities markets. Founded in 2020 by Allister Furey and Samuel Gill, Sylvera combines remote sensing, machine learning over satellite imagery and LiDAR-derived biomass data, and on-the-ground project assessment to produce letter-graded ratings (e.g., AA, A, B) for carbon credit projects across nature-based (REDD+, ARR, IFM), engineered removals, renewable energy, and cookstove methodologies. The platform's product surface spans Ratings, Market Intelligence (supply, demand, and pricing signals), an Article 6 & CORSIA Hub for compliance risk, a Market Gateway to roughly 400 million tonnes of project inventory, Earth Analytics and a Biomass Atlas for geospatial MRV, and Commodity Insights covering CORSIA, LCFS, CFR, and FuelEU Maritime mechanism eligibility and carbon intensity assessments. Sylvera distributes its data through a web platform, downloadable reports, and a gated Carbon Credit Analytics API (base URL https://api.sylvera.com/v1, JSON API style, API-key auth) used to syndicate ratings and pricing into ESG and sustainability reporting tools such as Workiva, Persefoni, and Watershed. Commercial packaging runs Freemium, Essentials, and Enterprise tiers, with Accelerated Ratings, Market Forecasts, and Geospatial add-ons all sold via contact-sales; there is no public OpenAPI specification, no published SDK, and no Sylvera GitHub organization — the API and full ratings catalog are available only to authenticated enterprise customers.

companies.description: Vedana Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biotechnology company developing next-generation medicines for migraine prevention. companies.name: Terrascope
companies.description: Terrascope is a Singapore-headquartered climate-tech and sustainability software company building an enterprise carbon measurement, management, and decarbonization platform. Launched in 2022 after being incubated and spun out of Olam Group (a Temasek-linked Singapore agribusiness), and led by former Google and AWS executive Felipe Daguila, Terrascope serves large food, agriculture, retail, and manufacturing enterprises that need to quantify Scope 1, 2, and 3 emissions across their operations, products, and supply chains. The platform centers on four core modules: Corporate Carbon Footprint (CCF) for organization-level inventories, Product Carbon Footprint (PCF) for product-level lifecycle emissions, Supplier Engagement for Scope 3 primary-data collection, and Climate Reporting for audit-ready disclosure. Terrascope's differentiator is its AI-assisted data ingestion layer (built on Amazon Bedrock) that reduces measurement cycles by roughly 80% versus manual baselines, intelligent emissions factor matching with FLAG (Forestry, Land, and Agriculture) breakdowns, data gap-filling claiming 92% accuracy versus supplier data, and a curated library of over 20,000 decarbonization best practices used to power what-if scenario modeling and ROI-ranked recommendations. The platform supports the GHG Protocol (including Land Sector and Removals guidance), SBTi FLAG, CDP (Terrascope is a CDP Gold Accredited software provider), TCFD, California SB253, and Australia's S2 climate disclosure regimes. Notable customers include Kellanova, Princes Group, iNova Pharmaceuticals, Mandai Wildlife Group, Olam Food Ingredients, Tetra Pak, Mitsubishi, Japan Tobacco, and Kagome. Investors include Olam Group and Plug and Play Tech Center. Terrascope is delivered as a closed enterprise SaaS — there is no publicly documented developer API, OpenAPI specification, SDK, CLI, or open-source release. The github.com/terrascope organization exists but has no public repositories, and docs.terrascope.com is not publicly resolvable. Integration with customer ERP, procurement, and energy systems is handled through bespoke implementation engagements rather than self-serve developer onboarding.

companies.description: Arago (Arago Computing SAS) is a Paris-based deeptech semiconductor startup, founded in 2024 by Nicolas Muller, Ambroise Muller, and Eliott Sarrey, building energy-efficient AI accelerators powered by light rather than electricity. Arago pairs the hardware with a full software stack called CARLOTA, which abstracts the complexities of photonic computing and exposes a programmable interface compatible with mainstream AI frameworks such as PyTorch and TensorFlow, while remaining fabbable using standard semiconductor processes. The company operates across France, North America, and Israel, and in July 2025 raised an oversubscribed $26 million seed round co-led by Earlybird, Protagonist, and Visionaries Tomorrow, with backing from executives and investors tied to Apple, Arm, Nvidia, Microsoft, Amazon, Uber, PayPal, and Hugging Face. companies.name: Inmarsat
companies.description: Inmarsat is a British satellite communications operator founded in 1979, originally as the International Maritime Satellite Organization, providing voice, data, broadband, and IoT services over a global L-band, Ka-band, and multi-band fleet of geostationary satellites. In May 2023 Viasat completed its acquisition of Inmarsat, and the combined company now operates Inmarsat's GX (Global Xpress), BGAN, IsatData Pro (IDP), and Fleet Xpress services alongside Viasat's ViaSat-3 constellation as a unified multi-orbit network. Inmarsat serves four core markets — Maritime (NexusWave, Fleet Xpress, Fleet One, FleetBroadband, Inmarsat C/GMDSS), Aviation (SwiftBroadband, GX Aviation, Jet ConneX, SB-S safety services), Government (L-TAC, GX, BGAN M2M), and Enterprise/IoT (BGAN M2M, IsatData Pro, IsatM2M, NB-NTN). Inmarsat operates a developer program at developer.inmarsat.com with documented APIs for BGAN network management, GSPS voice, Global Xpress, IsatData Pro messaging, Fleet Edge assurance, and Fleet Edge hardware replacement; access to interactive Swagger documentation is gated behind developer registration and approval, though the IsatData Pro Messaging API has an open-source Apache-2.0 Node.js client published on GitHub. Inmarsat is also one of the participating operators in the GSMA NB-NTN (Non-Terrestrial Network) standards work for satellite-extended cellular IoT, with Viasat-led proof-of-concept code for NIDD (Non-IP Data Delivery) published under the inmarsat-enterprise GitHub organization.

companies.name: Insurdata
companies.description: Insurdata is a re/insurance technology company providing global, best-in-class geocoding and property exposure data. Its unique multi-sourced methodology delivers the highest-resolution, building-level geocoding available worldwide, together with building-perimeter and property-characteristic data that lets underwriters and catastrophe modelers assess risk at the individual-property level at the point of underwriting. Insurdata's augmented exposure data has been used in collaborative studies with carriers such as Canopius and flood modelers such as Fathom to sharpen exposure levels and average-annual-loss (AAL) forecasts. The company is a portfolio company of Anthemis and serves the global re/insurance market.

Community-validated narratives are measured through read rates, micro-transactions, and engagement, then graduate into vertical-drama production and licensable intellectual property — a "story IP engine." KAMI is a consumer product (2.5M+ users) with no public developer API; it is part of the wearekami.com ecosystem and a 500 Global Creators Ventures portfolio company, added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment.

companies.name: Verdex
companies.description: Verdex builds AI for the clinical workflow. Its first product rooms patients and takes their history by voice before the physician walks into the room: the agent gathers and organizes the patient's story, hands the physician a three-sentence summary, and lands a structured, signable history back in the electronic health record (EHR) the practice already runs. The agent never diagnoses or advises, escalates anything urgent to staff immediately, keeps every line of the note traceable to its source, and is built to be HIPAA compliant. Verdex is aimed at clinicians, practice owners, and health-system teams. The company is an early-stage Y Combinator startup; verdexai.com is a browser-rendered marketing site that publishes machine-readable llms.txt, robots.txt, and a security.txt but does not (yet) expose a public API, developer portal, SDKs, or OpenAPI surface.

Positioned as "the AI processing unit for mortgage title and closing," Vestris aims to replace manual title searchers and accelerate property deal closing. Founded in 2025 and launched publicly in March 2026, Armadin is headquartered in San Francisco and was co-founded by Kevin Mandia (founder of Mandiant, former FireEye CEO) alongside former Mandiant and Google Cloud Security leaders. The company pairs agentic AI "attacker swarms" with elite human red teamers to deliver continuous, 24/7 red teaming and prioritized remediation, framed as a response to AI-driven machine-speed "Hyperattacks." Forward-deployed engineers configure each agent per operation; Arzana reports going live in 120 days with 99%+ accuracy. Arzana currently exposes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface; it does publish a /llms.txt for agent discovery.

The platform lets circuit designers submit a schematic and receive optimized layouts in minutes rather than the weeks of manual transistor-by-transistor placement that analog EDA traditionally requires. Astrus raised $8M in seed funding led by Khosla Ventures with participation from Pradeep Sindhu, 1517 Fund, Drive Capital and Alumni Ventures. companies.name: Campbell Soup
companies.description: Campbell Soup Company (now rebranded as The Campbell's Company) is a manufacturer and marketer of high-quality branded convenience food products, including soups, simple meals, beverages, snacks, and packaged fresh foods under brands such as Campbell's, Swanson, Pace, Prego, V8, Pepperidge Farm, Goldfish, and Snyder's of Hanover. Historically Campbell's ran a public Campbell's Kitchen Developer API exposing recipes, products, UPC lookup, and nutrition data for web and mobile integrations, though current availability of the public developer portal varies and typically requires partner access.

companies.name: data.egov.bg (Open Data Portal of Bulgaria)
companies.description: data.egov.bg is the national government open-data portal for Bulgaria, operated by the Ministry of e-Government (Министерство на електронното управление). It is a custom Laravel application exposing a REST API with action-style endpoints (predominantly POST with JSON bodies) under the /api prefix. It is not CKAN. Public read endpoints require no key; write/admin endpoints require an api_key obtained via a free account.

companies.name: data.gov.hr
companies.description: data.gov.hr (Portal otvorenih podataka) is the national government open-data portal for Croatia, operated by the Ministry of Justice and Public Administration. It runs CKAN 2.9.9 and exposes the standard CKAN Action API over approximately 3,858 datasets, supporting programmatic dataset search, metadata retrieval, and resource access, plus DCAT-AP RDF/XML catalog feeds for EU harvesting. Note that the CKAN API is mounted under a non-default /ckan/ path prefix; root-level CKAN URLs return the Vue single-page-app HTML rather than JSON.

companies.name: data.gov.rs
companies.description: data.gov.rs is the national government open-data portal for the Republic of Serbia, operated by the Office for IT and eGovernment. It runs the uData platform and exposes the uData REST API over approximately 3,452 datasets, supporting programmatic dataset search, metadata retrieval, organization listings, and resource access. The API provides a consistent JSON-over-HTTP interface and is harvested into the EU data portal.

companies.name: dataset.gov.md (Portalul Datelor Deschise)
companies.description: dataset.gov.md is the national government open-data catalog for the Republic of Moldova (Portalul Datelor Deschise). The landing portal at date.gov.md links out to this catalog, which runs CKAN 2.10.4 and exposes the standard CKAN Action API over approximately 1,275 datasets, supporting programmatic dataset search, metadata retrieval, and resource access. No API key is required for read endpoints.

companies.name: Fibraweb, S.p.a.
companies.description: Fibraweb S.p.A. is an Italian telecommunications infrastructure operator, founded in 2012 and headquartered in Perugia (Umbria), that designs, builds and operates its own fiber-optic access network for businesses, wholesale operators and public administrations. The company delivers FTTH/FTTB ultra-broadband internet access, dedicated internet access circuits, and local and long-distance voice/telephony services across the Umbria, Marche, Toscana and Lazio regions, with a proprietary network of roughly 1,500 km of fiber reaching 150 industrial zones and the ability to connect over 30,000 companies. Fibraweb is a Battery Ventures portfolio company (investors also include Equiter and GTD Grupo Teleductos) and holds ISO 9001, ISO/IEC 27001 and ISO/IEC 27017 certifications. It was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead; the company does not currently publish a public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation.

companies.name: Hinge Health
companies.description: Hinge Health is a San Francisco-based digital musculoskeletal (MSK) care company founded in 2014 by Daniel Perez and Gabriel Mecklenburg, delivering virtual physical therapy, pelvic health, and chronic pain care to enterprise health plans, employers, and their members. The platform combines on-demand exercise therapy with a multidisciplinary care team — physical therapists, health coaches, board-certified physicians, and orthopedic specialists — augmented by 3D motion tracking, computer vision, and an in-house AI Care Assistant. Hinge Health develops Enso, an FDA-cleared, drug-free wearable that delivers proprietary electrical stimulation waveforms for pain relief, and operates HingeConnect, an EMR/claims interoperability layer that ingests records from more than one million external providers across 120,000+ care sites to coordinate care, surface surgical and opioid risk, and feed real-time clinical context into the digital clinic. The company also runs HingeSelect, a national provider network for in-person MSK care, and contracts with all five major US national health plans plus employers including Boeing, Salesforce, and US Foods. Hinge Health raised more than $1 billion from Insight Partners, Tiger Global, Coatue, and Atomico before completing its IPO on the New York Stock Exchange under the ticker HNGE on May 22, 2025, pricing at $32/share and opening at $39.25 for an initial market capitalization above $3 billion. There is no public developer API, SDK, or open-source release for Hinge Health, Enso, or HingeConnect — the platform is sold as a managed clinical service to health plans and employers, and the HingeConnect interoperability surface is operated internally rather than exposed to third-party developers.

companies.name: Jumia
companies.description: Jumia is a pan-African e-commerce company often described as the "Amazon of Africa." Headquartered in Berlin and listed on the New York Stock Exchange under the ticker JMIA since its 2019 IPO, Jumia Technologies AG operates a third-party marketplace, a logistics network (Jumia Logistics), and a digital payments arm (JumiaPay) across eight African markets as of 2026: Egypt, Ghana, Ivory Coast, Kenya, Morocco, Nigeria, Senegal, and Uganda. The company exited Algeria in February 2026 and previously wound down Cameroon, Gabon, Rwanda, and Tunisia as part of a multi-year restructuring program targeting full-year profitability in 2027. Jumia's commerce platform connects more than 100,000 sellers with consumers across diverse categories including phones and electronics, fashion, home and living, beauty, FMCG, and groceries. Its developer surface is non-trivial: the Jumia Vendor API (vendor center, OAuth 2.0) supports order, inventory, product, and shipment integration for marketplace sellers, while the legacy SellerCenter API (a SellerCenter / Rocket Internet lineage shared with Lazada and Daraz) remains documented with PHP, Python, Ruby, and Node SDKs. JumiaPay exposes a Merchant API for payment creation, verification, refund, recurring-payment agreements, and callback-based webhooks, plus official WooCommerce and Magento payment-gateway plugins. The Jumia GitHub organization is sparse (an open-source playbook, Jumia Tech Blog, and Tech in Porto event site) while the JumiaPay AIG GitHub org hosts the WooCommerce and Magento gateway plugins under Apache 2.0.

companies.name: Legora
companies.description: Legora is a Stockholm- and London-based legal AI company (formerly Leya) building a collaborative AI workspace for lawyers. The platform is centered on Legora aOS, an agentic operating system that connects information, communication, and the execution of legal work across Agent, Monitors, Lists, Legal Research, Tabular Review, Workflows, and the client-facing Portal, with Word and Outlook add-ins, an Editor, and a mobile app. Legora is sold to elite law firms and in-house legal teams via enterprise contracts; customers include Mannheimer Swartling, Goodwin Procter, Cleary Gottlieb, Linklaters, Bird & Bird, and HWL Ebsworth, with 400+ firms across 40+ countries. There is no public, self-serve developer API, SDK, or open-source release; integrations are arranged through enterprise sales and partnership engagements, and the platform runs on Azure OpenAI Service with SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, ISO 42001, GDPR, and HIPAA controls.

companies.name: Lizee
companies.description: Lizee is a Paris-based Retail-as-a-Service platform that helps brands and retailers launch and operate circular commerce programs — rental, resale, and second-hand — end to end. Its stack pairs a rental platform, a resale/e-commerce platform, and a logistics platform (returns, refurbishment, reverse logistics) behind an operations API so a brand can offer rent or buy-back experiences on top of its existing catalog. Lizee runs a production API (api.lizee.io) and publishes a public Atlassian Statuspage, though it does not expose a public developer portal, OpenAPI definition, or SDKs — the API surface is partner and integration facing. Lizee was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Speedinvest.

companies.name: Raspire
companies.description: Raspire (RASPIRE) provides runtime security for mobile applications, positioning itself as the first line of defense for Android and iOS apps against AI-powered fraud attacks, API abuse, and runtime threats. Developers upload compiled apps (APK/IPA) and Raspire automatically hardens them with anti-fraud protection, app integrity verification, reverse-engineering prevention, and API protection, without requiring changes to application source code. The platform gives security teams real-time visibility into threats and blocks attacks in real time, and can integrate with existing SIEM systems and application monitoring platforms as part of a CI/CD pipeline. Raspire is a Y Combinator company. As surfaced to the API Evangelist network it does not publish a public developer API, OpenAPI specification, or SDKs; this profile captures its identity and probed domain-security posture.

companies.name: Umony
companies.description: Umony is a London-based communications compliance platform, founded in 2017 and backed by Seedcamp, that captures, records, and archives employee voice calls, SMS, WhatsApp, and Microsoft Teams conversations at the telecom-network level for banks and other regulated financial institutions. Its platform spans the Umony App (BYOD softphone), Umony Mobile (eSIM carrier-level capture), and Umony Archive with AI risk scoring, and the company holds BSI-certified ISO 27001:2022, ISO 42001:2023, and ISO 22301:2019 certifications. Umony publishes no public developer API surface today.

companies.name: Vesta
companies.description: Vesta is an AI-native mortgage Loan Origination System (LOS) — a modern, open system-of-record platform that orchestrates the loan manufacturing process through configurable software workflows and AI agents that run real loans end to end. Founded in 2020 by former Blend employees Mike Yu and Devon Yang and headquartered in San Francisco, Vesta gives mortgage lenders a cloud, API-and-integration-friendly LOS to replace legacy origination systems, connecting to the broader mortgage technology ecosystem. The company raised an Andreessen Horowitz (a16z)-led Series A. Vesta sells to lenders through a demo/partner-signup enterprise motion and does not currently expose a public self-serve developer API, portal, or documentation surface.

companies.name: Anywhere 2 Go
companies.description: Anywhere 2 Go Co., Ltd. is a Bangkok, Thailand insurtech company and the maker of Claim Di, a mobile application ecosystem that streamlines motor insurance claims and vehicle inspection between drivers, independent surveyors, and insurance companies. Its flagship "Shake and Go" (K4K) feature lets two Claim Di users resolve minor accidents on the spot, while Emergency Alert, self-service Car Inspection, photo-based Non-Accident Claims, and the Claim Di Bike surveyor-dispatch program cut claim processing time and help insurers reduce fraud. The company is a 500 Global portfolio company. Claim Di is a consumer/B2B mobile product (iOS and Android); no public developer API or documentation surface was found during enrichment.

companies.name: Apptronik
companies.description: Apptronik is an Austin, Texas-based humanoid robotics company founded in 2016 as a spinout from the Human Centered Robotics Lab at the University of Texas at Austin. Co-founded by Jeff Cardenas (CEO), Dr. Nick Paine (CTO), and Dr. Luis Sentis (scientific advisor), the company designs and manufactures Apollo, a general-purpose humanoid robot standing 5'8", weighing 160 lbs, capable of lifting 55 lbs, and running for roughly 4 hours on a swappable battery. Apollo targets warehouse, manufacturing, and logistics applications including trailer unloading, case picking, palletization, machine tending, and workcell delivery. Apptronik has commercial pilot programs and partnerships with Mercedes-Benz (automotive manufacturing logistics), GXO Logistics (multi-phase R&D in U.S. distribution centers), Jabil (supply-chain partner helping scale production and an internal Apollo deployment), and Google DeepMind (Apollo integrates Gemini Robotics vision-language-action models). The company previously built NASA's Valkyrie humanoid and ten-plus other research robots. As of February 2026 Apptronik had raised more than $935M (including a $520M Series A-X extension) at a reported $5B valuation, with investors including B Capital, Google, and Mercedes-Benz. The company sells/leases Apollo to enterprise customers via a direct contact-sales motion and ships a proprietary "point-and-click" control suite for deploying solutions; there is no public developer portal, no published REST/AsyncAPI/gRPC API, no public SDK, no open-source release, and no public GitHub repositories under the `apptronik` org.

companies.name: Atomic AI
companies.description: Atomic AI is a biotechnology company fusing machine learning with structural biology to unlock RNA drug discovery. Founded in 2017 by Raphael Townshend and based in San Francisco, the company builds ATOM-1, an AI foundation model that predicts the three-dimensional structure of RNA to enable the discovery and optimization of RNA-targeted small molecules and RNA-based medicines for previously undruggable targets, including certain cancers and neurodegenerative diseases. Atomic AI pairs its proprietary 3D RNA structure engine with large-scale in-house wet-lab assays. It is backed by Playground Global, 8VC, Greylock, and others. Atomic AI operates as a proprietary R&D drug-discovery platform and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation; this profile captures its public identity and web-surface signals for the API Evangelist network.

companies.name: Ayannah
companies.description: Ayannah (Ayannah Information Systems, Inc.) is a Philippines-based fintech company providing digital finance and digital commerce services to the emerging middle class across emerging markets, many of whom are migrants and/or unbanked. It operates a market-proven stack of digital financial services spanning payments, commerce, and analytics, reporting 10K+ touchpoints and 50M+ transactions processed. Marquee products include Sendah Direct (a B2B SaaS payment platform for retailers offering mobile top-ups, game credits, and domestic remittance, adopted in 7,000+ outlets), Sendah Remit (bank-grade interoperable international and domestic remittance), Sendah (a B2C gift-remittance service for Overseas Filipinos), and Asira (Indonesian B2B2C/B2C lending, insurance, and investment apps). Ayannah is backed by 500 Global. This profile is maintained by the API Evangelist network; the company publishes a corporate marketing site but no public developer portal, API documentation, or machine-readable API specification at this time.

companies.name: Barnes & Noble Education
companies.description: Barnes & Noble Education, Inc. (NYSE: BNED) is one of the largest operators of college bookstores in the United States, operating physical and virtual campus stores alongside digital course-materials and educational services. BNED reaches more than 5.7 million students through 1,125+ physical and virtual stores across higher education and K-12 institutions, primarily through its Barnes & Noble College Booksellers subsidiary and the MBS Textbook Exchange wholesale business. Flagship offerings include the First Day and First Day Complete affordable-access course-materials programs, BNC OER+ digital courseware, faculty adoption tools, campus retail and ecommerce services, and BNC AI Tools. BNED separated from Barnes & Noble, Inc. in August 2015 and is not affiliated with the Barnes & Noble retail bookstore chain. This repository captures any APIs, developer tools, and machine-readable artifacts associated with BNED. No public developer APIs or developer portal have been identified at this time; integrations with campus systems and learning-management systems are delivered through institutional partnerships rather than a public API surface.
